  • You’re comfortable saying “no” or “not yet” when a direction will materially harm UX or increase complexity, and you can propose pragmatic alternatives that keep the team unblocked.

  • You naturally connect your work to metrics and signals—whether usability, adoption, activation, or support volume—and you care about improving them over time, not just shipping v1.

  • You communicate design direction clearly so that PM and engineering partners feel bought‑in, understand the trade‑offs, and can advocate for the work even when you’re not in the room.


Qualifications

  • Experience: Typically 6–10+ years of product design experience, with a track record of acting as the primary designer for complex product areas and delivering measurable impact. Comfort working in fast‑moving environments where you need to ship iteratively while maintaining a high bar for UX.

  • Environment: You’ve worked in product organizations with multiple designers and cross‑functional partners, where you’ve had to influence, negotiate trade‑offs, and maintain standards—not just ship tickets.

  • Background: In‑house product design experience in products with real complexity (B2B SaaS, internal tools, workflows, creator tools, or similar). Experience in companies with multiple designers and cross‑functional teams.

  • Portfolio: A portfolio that shows end‑to‑end ownership of complex product work, clear articulation of problem framing, process and decision‑making, and measurable outcomes or learnings.

  • Tools: Proficiency with modern product design tools, working in shared design systems. Proficient in leveraging AI tools in your work, such as Claude Code or Figma Make.

  • Research: Experience planning and running lightweight user research and usability testing for your own projects.


Nice to have:

  • Experience designing for technical or semi‑technical users (developers, operators, agencies) or building tools that expose complexity in a manageable way.

  • Familiarity with no‑code/low‑code tools or app builders, whether from previous roles or from building your own projects.

  • Experience working on editors, IDEs, design tools, admin consoles, or other highly interactive, dense interfaces.


Compensation:

We offer competitive compensation aligned to tier one markets. Our estimated salary for this role at Bubble ranges from $162k - $209k. Actual pay is determined by multiple factors such as skills, qualifications, experience and market demand.

Location:

This is a remote-friendly role open to candidates authorized to work in the U.S. Our team is based in NYC and works Eastern Time.

We're currently set up to hire across most U.S. states.

States we're not currently set up to employ in: AK, AL, AR, DE, HI, ID, IA, KS, KY, LA, ME, MT, NE, NH, NM, ND, OK, RI, SC, SD, VT, WV, WY. If you're in one of these states but open to relocating to NYC, we'd still love to hear from you.

If you'd like to join us in New York, we're happy to help with relocation. We prefer hiring within commuting distance of our Manhattan office because we value getting together in person regularly — folks who come in enjoy catered lunches, team events, and other perks.

Benefits:

In addition to cash and equity compensation, Bubble offers a robust benefits package equating to roughly twenty thousand in additional annual compensation:

Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

  • Comprehensive health coverage

  • 401(k) matching

  • Wellness and work enablement stipends

  • Generous PTO

  • A Sabbatical program

Join us!

Let’s democratize access to technology together! If this sounds like you, apply! If you don’t meet all of the qualifications but think you could be a match, we’d still love the chance to review your application. At Bubble, we encourage people from all ages, abilities, and experiences to apply. Bubble does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, ancestry, religion, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital or family status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, pregnancy or caregiver status, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Perhaps this job doesn't fit your background? Join our talent community!

canals-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Canals

Canals builds software for wholesale distributors, helping them operate more efficiently through automation and AI.

Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Every day, thousands of people rely on Canals to help process orders, manage purchasing, handle accounts payable, and streamline critical business workflows.

We're a profitable, rapidly growing company with a team of roughly 100 people distributed across North and South America. We care deeply about building great products, hiring exceptional people, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.


The Role

As a Senior Product Designer at Canals, you'll play a central role in shaping the future of distribution through AI-powered products. You'll partner closely with product, engineering, and company leadership to turn complex operational challenges into intuitive, high-impact product experiences.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership. You'll work across multiple product areas, from core workflows to entirely new capabilities, taking ideas from early exploration through launch and continuous iteration. You'll help shape AI-powered product experiences, designing workflows that help users make smarter decisions and accomplish more with less manual effort.

We're looking for someone who's comfortable with ambiguity, driven by impact, and motivated by the opportunity to shape the future of our product while helping design evolve as the company grows.

The tools you use matter. The way you think and make decisions matters more.

What You'll Do

  • Lead the end-to-end design of new products and features, bringing clarity to complex, cross-functional challenges.

  • Work across multiple product areas, balancing shifting priorities while making informed decisions and moving quickly.

  • Partner closely with product and engineering to define problems, shape solutions, and drive products from concept to launch.

  • Get involved early, when problems are still messy and directions aren't set, and shape the conversation, not just respond to it.

  • Prototype ideas, test assumptions, and iterate based on customer feedback and product data.

  • Balance long-term product vision with fast-paced execution, making thoughtful tradeoffs as priorities evolve.

  • Raise the bar for the overall product experience while contributing to the evolution of our design system.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience designing complex B2B SaaS products, ideally involving operational workflows, data-rich experiences, or AI-powered products.

  • A portfolio that demonstrates how you think: framing complex problems and translating them into intuitive, user-centered products.

  • Strong product thinking and the ability to connect design decisions to customer needs and business outcomes.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, with the judgment to know which details matter most.

  • Confidence to advocate for your ideas, challenge assumptions, and influence product decisions while remaining open to feedback and new perspectives.

  • A curious mindset and a desire to explore how AI and emerging technologies can improve real customer workflows.

Why Join Canals

We're building software that solves real problems for an industry that keeps the world running. Our customers rely on our platform every day to operate their businesses.

We've found strong product-market fit and continue to grow quickly, creating opportunities for people who want to have a meaningful impact on the trajectory of a company.

We believe great people build great companies. That's why we invest heavily in hiring, development, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.

You'll work alongside ambitious, thoughtful teammates who care deeply about what they do, challenge each other directly, and have a lot of fun along the way.

We value ownership, transparency, and continuous improvement. Good ideas can come from anywhere, and people are trusted to make things happen.

We're remote-first, flexible, and distributed across North and South America, bringing together talented people from a wide range of backgrounds and experiences.

Canals.ai is an equal opportunity employer. In addition to EEO being the law, it is a policy that is fully consistent with our principles. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to status as a protected veteran or a qualified individual with a disability, or other protected status such as race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, genetic information, pregnancy or age.

cardboard-founding-designer.descriptionHtml:
About

  • We're building the future of storytelling and video editing.
  • We're a small team that moves fast and builds things we're proud of.
  • We care obsessively about taste: in design, in product, in every detail.
  • We're solving these hard problems.
  • We're backed by a Tier-1 global fund, YC, and founders of billion dollar companies.

Cardboard is the agentic video editor. It actually watches your footage, so it can search across tens of gigs, pull the right clips, sync to the beat, and source everything else (music, graphics, sfx, etc.) it needs. The final cut comes out in your brand's language, and all of this happens inside the browser.

You'd be surrounded by people who are absurdly good at what they do. One started coding at 11 and shipped 6M+ downloads. One got into CS engineering at 14 and has been working on distributed systems for 8+ years. One's an ex-founder who took a company to 1.2M users and $300M+ in transactions. That's the team. We're looking for someone who'll raise the bar on the creative side the way we have on the technical and business side.

Design

Video is the most powerful way humans tell stories. It always has been. But creating it today is still painfully hard. Fragmented tools, steep learning curves, and workflows that get in the way of the actual creative work. We're building Cardboard to change that.

As our founding designer, you'll shape not just how the product looks, but how it works. You think product first and push back when something doesn't serve the user, and think through every user flow before a component gets shipped.

In our team, everyone has incredible speed, taste, and care that they put into their work. You'll often see people coming up with micro-interactions nobody asked for and losing sleep over things that feel slightly off by a sheer two pixels. Your job is to accelerate and harness that energy to make sure everything we build feels cohesive and intentional.

You will

  • Own product design end to end: flows, UI, prototypes, and everything in between.
  • Advocate for the user in every room like a PM does.
  • Work closely with founders, engineering, and growth.
  • Build a design system.
  • Make something people love.

Who you are

  • You have taste.
  • You own things end-to-end.
  • You think like a PM. You notice the extra click, the label doing two jobs, the feature that shipped but isn't really done.
  • AI-pilled and restlessly curious. Rive, Spline, Paper, Reve, Claude design, whatever dropped last week, you've already tried it.
  • You're a Figma expert. You love micro-interactions. You've probably built parts of a design system, or at least felt the pain of not having one.
  • Resourceful. When you need an illustrator, motion designer, or freelancer, you find them and direct them well.
  • Bonus: you vibe coded or shipped a side project.

What you get

  • Competitive salary and founding-team equity.
  • Relocation to SF, including visa / immigration support.
  • Unlimited tokens. Use whatever you want, as much as you want.
  • A healthy budget for tools, monitors, laptop, and anything you need to do your best work.

centralize-founding-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Centralize

Enterprise sales runs on relationships, and every tool built to manage them is a database from 2005. Reps lose seven-figure deals because they can't see who actually matters inside an account. We're building the system of intelligence that replaces the CRM.

Centralize is the relationship intelligence platform for enterprise revenue teams. Webflow, Intercom, Brex, Cognition, LangChain, and Cresta use us to close their largest deals. We've grown 5x since last year, and customers are pulling us forward faster than we can ship.

We just raised a Series A led by NEA, bringing our total funding to $18M+ alongside Salesforce Ventures, Y Combinator, and operators including Cal Henderson (Co-Founder, Slack), Noah Weiss (former CPO, Slack), and sales leaders from Figma, Box, Dropbox, Anthropic, and Notion.

Centralize was founded by Rachit Kataria, a founding engineer on Facebook Shops who helped scale it to 250M MAUs, and Will Wang, who led the launch of Slack Huddles, the fastest-growing product in Slack's history.

Our Bar

We stay small on purpose. No passengers, no politics, no waiting for permission or for someone else to fix what's broken.

We own the unglamorous work alongside the exciting work. The 9pm customer request, the integration buried three layers deep, the bug nobody wants to touch. You go after it because it needs to get done, and because the next thing you build is better for it.

You won't have the answers handed to you. The roadmap, the visual direction, the right call on a customer request, you'll be the one figuring it out. We hire people who are energized by ambiguity, not slowed down by it.

Your work shapes what Centralize becomes.

The Role

We are hiring our first designer. Enterprise software is a graveyard of bad interfaces, and we have a rare opportunity to build the product that proves enterprise tools can feel as good as the consumer software people actually love.

As our Founding Designer, you will own how Centralize looks and feels everywhere it shows up. The product, the design system, the brand, the website, the marketing. You'll define the visual language for an entire product category from a blank canvas, and grow into the leader who builds the design team behind it.

This role is well-suited to designers with serious visual taste and range, who think past the obvious solution, and who want full ownership of design at a company moving fast enough to use all of it.

What You Will Do

  • Own product design end to end. The flows, the components, the interaction patterns, the system that ties them together.

  • Build and evolve our design system. Color, typography, spacing, components, made scalable enough that the next ten engineers ship fast without breaking the visual bar.

  • Own the brand. The identity, the voice, the way Centralize looks and feels across every surface beyond the product.

  • Design the marketing assets. The website, launch material, decks, and social, often the first impression anyone has of Centralize.

  • Talk to customers. Sit on sales calls, watch users navigate the product, and turn what you see into design decisions.

  • Set the standard for visual and craft quality at Centralize, and raise it every day.

  • Lay the foundation for the design team you will eventually help hire and lead.

What Success Looks Like

  • Week 1: First design shipped to production.

  • Day 30: Owning the design of a major product surface end to end, with the design system taking shape.

  • Day 90: The product and brand feel noticeably better than the day you joined, the design system is yours, and customers are commenting on the craft.

What We Are Looking For

  • A portfolio that makes the case for itself. We care about the work, not the resume. Show us the product surfaces, the brand work, and the details you've shipped.

  • Sharp visual taste. You can look at a screen and see what's wrong, and look at a blank screen and know what should go there.

  • Range across product design, design systems, typography, and brand. You move between a dense enterprise workflow and a marketing page without losing the thread.

  • The instinct to think past the template. You find the solution nobody else saw, and you can tell when the unexpected choice is the right one.

  • You don't stop at the static mockup. At minimum you prototype your designs to a high fidelity, and ideally you take them into code yourself, whether by hand or with tools like Claude Code. The dream hire ships their own work to production.

  • Excellent written and verbal English communication. You can explain a design decision in a doc, defend it in a meeting, and demo it to a customer.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate independently. We give you the goal, not the steps.

This Role Is Not For You If

  • You want a team of designers around you to bounce ideas off. You will be our first designer, and the bar is set by you.

  • You want to work only on product, or only on brand. This role owns all of it.

  • You optimize for the perfect design at the expense of shipping. We grade on what's in production, not what's in Figma.

  • You want a slower pace. We work hard and move quickly. Please only apply if that excites you.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience as the first designer or a design-leaning founding hire at a fast-growing startup.

  • Background shipping consumer-grade UI in a B2B product. Bonus if you've worked in CRM, sales tools, or other enterprise software categories.

  • Fluency building in code (React, modern CSS) and shipping your own designs to production.

  • Experience building and maintaining a design system at scale.

  • Brand or marketing design work that shows range beyond the product.

  • Interest in growing into a design leader and building the team.

The Team You'll Join

You'll work directly with Rachit and Will, alongside former founders and engineers from Coinbase, Gusto, Modern Treasury, and C3 AI.

Compensation and Logistics

  • Location: This role is open to remote candidates in the US, with a strong preference for candidates based in or willing to relocate to San Francisco or New York City.

  • Work Authorization: We are unable to sponsor visas. Candidates must have existing US work authorization.

  • Compensation: $170,000 – $240,000 base salary depending on level, plus 0.20% to 0.40% equity. Final offer calibrated to seniority and experience.

Benefits

  • Fully covered medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k)

  • Parental leave

  • Unlimited PTO plus company holidays

  • Quarterly offsite

  • Equipment stipend

chorus-innovations-principal-product-des.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Chorus Innovations is a fast-growing healthcare technology company with an adaptive platform as a service (PaaS) that enables the rapid development of mobile, desktop, text messaging and interactive voice applications. Chorus’ platform currently powers transformative healthcare, biomedical research and community health projects across institutions and public health agencies nationwide. We believe every community should have world-class health technology so they can thrive.

Our mission is to improve the lives of people and communities by democratizing technology development in health and research.

About the Role

As a Principal Product Designer at Chorus, you will lead the charge in crafting visually stunning and highly intuitive user experiences that solve complex challenges in health at scale. This role requires a unique blend of strategic vision, systems thinking, and a passion for world-class visual design. As a key architect of the design strategy, you’ll ensure cohesive, innovative solutions that resonate with users and deliver measurable impact across the organization.

Collaborating with cross-functional teams, you’ll champion design excellence as both a critical function and a strategic advantage. Leveraging your deep understanding of complex systems and an eye for detail, you’ll transform complex and confusing workflows into simple, elegant, and effective solutions that empower users and advance our mission.

Please note, this is a contract-to-hire opportunity, starting as a contractor/freelance role with the potential to convert to a full-time employee role

What You’ll Be Doing

Design Strategy & Vision

  • Define and drive the product design vision for high-impact initiatives, ensuring alignment with user needs and company goals. Advocate for design excellence across the organization, balancing business, technical, and customer perspectives.

Lead by Example

  • Set the standard for design quality through hands-on contributions, including user flows, interaction models, wireframes, and visually compelling mockups. Serve as a champion for cohesive and inclusive design practices.

Collaboration & Partnership

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with product managers, engineers, researchers, and stakeholders. Lead discussions to align on goals, dependencies, and trade-offs. Partner with engineering to bring design concepts to life, maintaining quality and consistency.

Mentorship & Culture

  • Inspire and mentor designers, fostering an environment of learning and creative exploration. Cultivate a culture of innovation, empathy, and inclusion that enables every team member to thrive and contribute their best work.

Design Leadership

  • Advocate for user-centered design thinking and the role of design in achieving business outcomes. Act as a design system steward, guiding teams to maintain and evolve standards for visual, interaction, and accessibility excellence.

Storytelling & Influence

  • Communicate compelling narratives that articulate the rationale behind design decisions, inspire stakeholders, and align cross-functional teams. Use data, customer insights, and prototypes to build alignment around shared goals.

What Makes you a Great Fit

Expertise in Craft & Strategy

  • A strong product design portfolio showcasing end-to-end design solutions that blend user empathy with measurable business outcomes. Experience defining and driving design strategies for large-scale, complex products.

Creative Problem-Solving

  • A love for untangling complexity, transforming ambiguity into actionable plans. You bring innovative ideas to the table and aren’t afraid to challenge the status quo.

Influence & Leadership

  • Proven ability to lead design initiatives, mentor peers, and inspire teams across disciplines. You thrive in environments where you can amplify the impact of your work through collaboration and influence.

Tools & Processes

  • Proficient in design tools like Figma and adept at using research, testing, and analytics to inform and iterate on your designs. Bonus points for experience with motion, design systems, prototyping, and accessibility standards.

Customer-Centric Mindset

  • You are passionate about understanding and solving user problems. Your designs are driven by research insights, market trends, and a desire to create equitable and delightful experiences for diverse audiences.

Who you are

  • 12+ years of professional design experience, with at least 3 years leading or mentoring other designers.
  • Experience designing for web, mobile, or cross-platform ecosystems at scale.
  • Exceptional communication skills, with a knack for influencing executive stakeholders and rallying teams around a vision.
  • A growth mindset and the ability to adapt in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Bonus points for experience working on PaaS or SaaS products.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us:

  • Engage with an exciting, fast-growing, and diverse group of coworkers dedicated to improving lives by breaking down technology barriers.
  • Work in a culturally rich environment that values diversity and inclusivity, ensuring a welcoming and supportive atmosphere for all employees
  • Full medical, dental, vision and life insurance benefits
  • 401K matching
  • Company stock options
  • Unlimited paid vacation
  • Performance bonuses
  • Company support for career and skill development
  • Fun company events and outings
  • Chorus is an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to diversity and inclusion

Compensation Disclosure
We are hiring for this position on a freelance contract basis with potential for conversion to a Full-Time Employee (FTE) role. The anticipated base salary for this position is $165,000 - $190,000 based on the Los Angeles market. The base salary offered may vary depending on several factors, including the applicant's qualifications, relevant experience, specific skills, level of education, certifications, and the geographic location where the role will be performed.

Please note that the listed compensation details apply to the base salary only and do not include additional elements of the total compensation package, such as performance bonuses, stock options, or benefits. The final compensation package will be determined by evaluating the candidate’s qualifications in relation to market standards and internal pay equity.

Chorus Innovations values diversity as a core principle of the work we do and the communities we serve. We are committed to equal employment opportunity, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religious creed, citizenship, marital status, age, national origin, ancestry, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, sex, sexual orientation, military and veteran status, gender, gender identity, gender expression, or any other protected characteristic.

Disability Accommodation for Applicants to Chorus Innovations

At Chorus Innovations, we are committed to fostering an inclusive and accessible workplace environment for all individuals, including job applicants with disabilities. We recognize the value that individuals with diverse abilities bring to our organization and are dedicated to providing equal opportunities for all applicants.

If you require accommodations at any stage of the job application process due to a disability, please inform us of your needs. We will do our best to work with you to ensure that reasonable accommodations are made to facilitate your participation in the recruitment process.

Please note that accommodations will be provided in a manner that respects your privacy and confidentiality. Disclosing a disability or requesting accommodations will not affect your candidacy or opportunities for employment with Chorus Innovations.

To request accommodations or discuss your needs further, please contact careers@joinchorus.com. We encourage you to reach out as early as possible to ensure that appropriate arrangements can be made.

Thank you for considering Chorus Innovations as a potential employer. We look forward to the opportunity to work together and to creating an inclusive workplace where all individuals can thrive.

citizen-product-design-engineer.descriptionHtml:
About Citizen

Citizen is building the world's largest real-time safety network.

Every day, millions of people rely on Citizen to understand what's happening around them and make better decisions in moments that matter. We're building products that help people navigate uncertainty, respond to emergencies, and stay connected to the world around them in real time.

We're looking for a Product Design Engineer to help define what comes next.

This role sits at the intersection of product design, engineering, and entrepreneurship. You'll work on some of Citizen's most important experiences—from alerts and live video to entirely new AI-powered safety products—helping transform ideas into products people trust and depend on.

We're looking for someone who can identify opportunities, design experiences, build working products, and influence the direction of what gets built next.

Someone who sees ambiguity as an opportunity rather than a problem.

Someone who would rather build a prototype than create a presentation.

Founding designers, startup builders, solo creators, design engineers, and product-minded technologists are especially encouraged to apply.

What You'll Do

  • Identify opportunities that create meaningful value for Citizen users

  • Design and prototype new product experiences from concept to execution

  • Work on core Citizen experiences including alerts, live video, maps, AI-powered features, and real-time safety workflows

  • Explore multiple product directions quickly through experimentation and rapid prototyping

  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data, Operations, and Leadership

  • Design systems, interactions, workflows, and behaviors—not just interfaces

  • Use AI to accelerate exploration, iteration, research, and product development

  • Help shape the future of personal safety technology

What We're Looking For

You might be:

  • A product designer who learned to build

  • A design engineer with exceptional product instincts

  • A founding designer from an early-stage startup

  • A founder who loves building products

  • A creative technologist who doesn't fit neatly into traditional roles

What matters most is your ability to turn ideas into products people use and value.

Strong Signals

  • Experience building products from 0→1

  • Exceptional product judgment and user empathy

  • Strong visual and interaction design skills

  • Ability to build functional prototypes that feel like real products

  • Comfort working across product strategy, design, and implementation

  • Curiosity about AI and emerging tools

  • A bias toward action and experimentation

  • Clear thinking and strong written communication

What Success Looks Like

Within your first few months, you'll help answer questions like:

  • How should AI help people stay safer in the real world?

  • How can we make critical information more useful and actionable?

  • What entirely new products should Citizen build next?

  • How can we prototype and validate ideas in days instead of months?

You'll be expected to contribute not just solutions, but direction.

What We Value

We care less about titles and credentials and more about evidence.

Show us products you've launched.

Show us systems you've created.

Show us experiments you've run.

Show us businesses, side projects, or tools you've built.

Show us examples where you identified the opportunity—not just executed someone else's roadmap.

We're especially interested in people who have repeatedly stepped into ambiguity and created clarity through building.

How to Apply

Along with your portfolio, answer these four questions:

  1. What's something you've built that nobody asked you to build?

  2. Why did you believe it was worth building?

  3. What did you learn after people started using it?

  4. How has AI changed the way you design or build products?

We care deeply about visual craft, product thinking, and execution. Show us work that demonstrates how you think, how you design, and how you bring ideas to life. We're interested in the decisions behind the work as much as the final outcome.

Salary Range
This role offers a base salary of $155,000–$215,000 per year, plus equity.

Compensation & Benefits
We offer competitive salary, equity, and a full benefits package, including:

  • At least one fully employer-sponsored medical plan option

  • Dental and vision coverage, with a small employee contribution

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Up to 14 weeks paid parental leave (for all parents)

  • Monthly tech stipend

  • Free mental health support

  • Hybrid work environment + catered lunches (NYC HQ)

Diversity, Equity & Inclusion at Citizen
Citizen is an equal opportunity employer. We’re building a team that reflects the diversity of the communities we serve — across race, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, ability, and background.

We know that diverse teams make better decisions and build more effective products. If you don’t meet every listed qualification, we still encourage you to apply. Skills, potential, and lived experience matter.

clarion-founding-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Clarion

At Clarion, we're rebuilding how healthcare communicates in the age of AI. Today, clinics miss 30-40% of patient calls while staff drowns in administrative tasks. We believe AI agents should handle these workflows—scheduling, billing, prescription refills—so healthcare teams can focus on actual patient care.

We're building the communication infrastructure that modern healthcare desperately needs. Our AI agents don't just answer calls; they complete entire workflows end-to-end, giving providers back their time and ensuring patients never go unheard. We've already handled hundreds of thousands of patient interactions across virtual care companies, health systems, and a $5B health insurance company.

Founded by a Stanford/Harvard-trained physician who was on the founding team of Two Chairs and Ophelia, and an ex-Amazon Alexa engineer who led AI/ML teams at Salesforce, we uniquely understand both the clinical and technical challenges of transforming healthcare communication.

We've raised $10M from Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia (scout), and healthcare founders from Ophelia, Medallion, and Counsel Health. We're an in-person team based in New York, moving fast to ensure no patient call goes unanswered.

Why Join Us?

  • Early-stage with strong market validation: We are rapidly growing and offering the high-impact environment of an early-stage startup

  • Solving a massive healthcare challenge: We're addressing a critical problem in healthcare communication that affects millions of patients

  • Cutting-edge tech frontier: You'll design both visual and voice experiences for breakthrough AI technology that's transforming healthcare communication

  • In-person collaboration advantage: We've built in-person since day one and maintain this as a strategic advantage—we move faster, build stronger bonds, and create a cohesive culture

What you'll be working on

  • Own our entire design language: Define Clarion's brand identity across all touchpoints—from marketing website to product interfaces to sales materials—ensuring we stand out in healthcare

  • Design AI voice experiences that feel human: Craft conversation flows, dialogue scripts, and interaction patterns that make our AI agents sound natural, empathetic, and trustworthy to patients

  • Create intuitive product interfaces: Build dashboards and tools that make complex AI capabilities feel simple for overwhelmed healthcare teams

  • Bridge the visual and auditory: Design cohesive experiences where what customers see perfectly complements what patients hear during AI conversations

  • Build our design system from scratch: Establish visual guidelines, component libraries, and voice interaction patterns that scale as we grow

  • Ship brand experiences at startup speed: Create everything from pitch decks to product demos to conference materials that make healthcare buyers stop and pay attention

Requirements

  • 3+ years of design experience: Portfolio showing both brand and product design work, with ability to create cohesive experiences across mediums

  • Full-stack designer: Comfortable moving from brand strategy to UI design to copywriting within the same day

  • Systems thinker: Can create scalable design frameworks for both visual and conversational interfaces

  • Figma fluent: Expert-level proficiency in design tools, with ability to create everything from logos to prototypes

  • In-person collaboration: Excited to work from our NYC office daily

You are a good fit if

  • You believe great design spans all senses—what people see, hear, and feel when interacting with a product

  • You're fascinated by making AI conversations feel natural and human, not robotic or scripted

  • You can write copy that sounds like a compassionate healthcare worker, not a tech company

  • You want to own both how Clarion looks and how it sounds to millions of patients

  • You're excited to define a brand that stands out in the sea of sterile healthcare tech

  • You measure success by both user delight and business impact

Interesting Design Challenges

  • Make AI feel human: Design voice scripts and interfaces that help patients trust they're getting real help, not talking to a robot

  • Smooth handoffs between AI and staff: Create seamless transitions when a conversation needs to move from AI to a human without confusing or frustrating the patient

  • Simplify complex healthcare workflows: Turn chaotic medical processes into clean, intuitive designs that busy staff can use without training

  • Show conversations clearly: Design dashboards that help staff quickly understand what happened in AI-patient calls and spot important issues

  • Give staff the right amount of control: Build systems that let healthcare teams oversee AI agents without creating extra work or slowing things down

  • Connect what's heard with what's seen: Make sure the AI's voice conversations match perfectly with what staff see on their screens

What we offer

  • Direct mentorship: Work closely with our founding team and shape both product and brand direction from day one

  • Meaningful equity: Early employee stock options with significant ownership potential

  • Comprehensive benefits: 100% covered healthcare, flexible time off, commuter benefits, daily team lunches

  • Team culture: Quarterly retreats and monthly team events that build real connections in our close-knit NYC team

  • Impact at scale: Your designs—both visual and voice—will directly improve healthcare access for millions

Interview Process

We'll get back to you within 24 hours after each step:

  • First Chat (20 min) [Virtual]: Quick conversation about your design philosophy and experience in complex product spaces

  • Portfolio Review (45 min) [Virtual]: Walk us through 2-3 projects that showcase your design process from research to shipped product

  • Design Exercise (Take-home): Tackle a real challenge we're facing around AI-patient communication interfaces

  • Team Day (Half-day) [In-Person]: Visit our NYC office for a collaborative design session, meet the team, and see how we work together

If you're ready to transform how millions of patients connect with their healthcare providers, we'd love to hear from you.

clariti-product-designer-contract.descriptionHtml:
Join our mission to provide governments with exceptional experiences so they can do the same for their communities!

What do we do?💥

We empower governments to deliver exceptional citizen experiences.

Check out our ‘About Us’page for a deep dive into our product and what makes us exceptional.

How will you help us make an impact? 👩‍💻👨‍💻

Clariti is seeking a skilled Product Designer to join our design team on a full-time contract basis through the end of 2026. This is a hands-on role for a designer who is energized by complexity, comfortable designing in a world where the design function is an integral part of an AI-native product development team. This isn’t a traditional design role as you’ll work directly inside an agentic build system using Claude and Figma in a hybrid workflow to craft designs. You’ll partner with our existing Senior Product Designer on the full design surface from UX research through to delivery, and you’ll be expected to shape how AI-native design works at Clariti.

This is a collaborative, fast-moving team where design operates as a valued partner to product and engineering. The work is meaningful, the canvas is wide, and the problems are genuinely hard. The successful candidate is passionate about creating experiences that make government work better for the people who run it and the citizens they serve.

As a Product Designer at Clariti, you’ll get to :

End-to-End Design Execution

  • Own the full design arc from user flows through wireframes, high-fidelity screens, and interactive prototypes.
  • Design experiences where AI is a natural part of the workflow translating complex capabilities into clear, trustworthy interactions.
  • Use a Figma + Claude Design hybrid workflow to generate and iterate on screens that produce production-ready UX/UI, build clickable HTML prototypes for demos and validation
  • Design for local municipal government staff and public applicant personas across complex, multi-role workflows.
  • Ensure every touchpoint is accessible, consistent, and built for real-world use.
  • Stay current on emerging design patterns particularly as AI changes how users interact with software and apply them with intentionality, not novelty.

Discovery & Research

  • Lead and participate in user research, such as interviews, usability testing, and synthesis leveraging AI-assisted tools to accelerate insight generation where appropriate.
  • Develop deep empathy for the problems local government staff face and translate that into design decisions grounded in evidence.
  • Partner with Product to validate concepts early and often, reducing delivery risk.

Design System & Component Contribution

  • Contribute to and extend a shared design system, maintaining consistency across a growing product surface area.
  • Collaborate with engineering to ensure components are buildable and design intent is preserved through implementation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and GTM teams to move work from idea to shipped.
  • Present work clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership.

What do you bring to the team? 🧠

  • 4+ years of product design experience, with a portfolio demonstrating strong UX thinking and high-quality visual execution.
  • Comfort designing products where AI is part of the experience, thinking about how AI changes user expectations and design for it accordingly
  • Hands-on experience with Claude or similar LLMs as a design partner
  • Proficiency in Figma & Claude Design, including component libraries and prototyping.
  • Strong end-to-end design skills: IA, flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity UI across web applications.
  • Experience leading or contributing to user research and usability testing.
  • Clear, confident communicator who can articulate design decisions and take feedback constructively.
  • Self-directed, accountable, and you are comfortable driving your own work forward in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.
  • Comfortable working in a remote-first environment

Bonus Points 🎉

  • Experience designing enterprise or government-facing SaaS products.
  • Exposure to design for complex, multi-persona, or workflow-heavy applications (e.g., case management, permitting, licensing).
  • Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1+) and inclusive design practices.
  • Familiarity with agentic development frameworks

What’s in it for you?🫵

This is a contract role running through December 31, 2026, with the possibility of extension. We’re looking for someone who can hit the ground running and make a meaningful contribution from day one over the course of 4-6 months. We're working with a budget of $70-100/hour based on the candidate’s skills, experience, and qualifications.

Things to Note 📝

Background checks - Because our customers trust us with sensitive information, we require all successful candidates to undergo comprehensive background checks before joining our team. We focus strictly on global sanctions and criminal offences that are directly relevant to employment at Clariti, and follow all applicable privacy and human rights legislation.

Travel- Although we operate as a remote company, all roles are expected to participate in occasional travel for in-person company-wide or departmental meetings, typically 1-2 times per year. Additional travel requirements specific to the role, if any, will be outlined in the job description.

We're committed to building an inclusive culture where our team members take ownership over projects, tasks, and outcomes; bring a growth mindset to drive continuous learning and self-development; have the ability to communicate courageously in a direct but respectful way; and are customer-focused by keeping the customer at the heart of decision-making. It’s the diversity of our team that helps us make better decisions, by leveraging the diversity in thought & experience across to create impactful solutions as we explore new paths & challenges as we grow. We’re working to create a workplace and team that is as diverse as the communities we serve. We welcome and encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply.

Questions? We are here to help

If you require accommodations in completing an application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in our hiring process for any reason, please direct your questions to hr@claritisoftware.com and we’ll be happy to support you.

clasp-principal-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Principal Product Designer

Remote (ET & CT time zones only — some travel required)

About Us

Clasp is a venture-backed, mission-driven startup transforming access to education and career pathways. We are revolutionizing the way employers attract and retain critical talent and the way colleges and universities support their students through education financing — all while tackling the student debt crisis. (Yep, we think BIG.) We like to think of ourselves as more than a fintech; we're a catalyst for economic mobility.

A Forbes Fintech 50 company, portfolio company of SHRM (Society of Human Resource Management — the world's largest HR professional society), and one of Business Insider's "43 Start-Ups to Bet Your Career On in 2025," Clasp is driven by our commitment to social impact and innovation.

What We Need

Clasp is looking for a Principal Product Designer to define design, brand, and taste across all of our user interactions.. This is a foundational, strategic hire — the person who sets the bar for how Clasp looks, feels, and earns trust, from the first marketing touchpoint a candidate ever sees through the products our users rely on every day.

You will own design as a discipline at Clasp. That means more than shipping screens: it means establishing the visual language, the design culture, and the standard of craft that everything else is measured against. You'll work across both our product surfaces and our marketing site, making sure a student who first encounters Clasp in an ad, lands on our site, signs an offer, and becomes an employee receiving their first repayment feels like they're moving through one coherent, considered, trustworthy experience.

This is a green-field mandate. You are not inheriting a mature design org or a rigid system to maintain — you are defining what design at Clasp is. You'll set the direction, build the foundations, and make the high-leverage calls about brand and product identity that we don't have anyone to make today. It's also a hands-on role: at this stage, you'll design and ship the work yourself while laying the groundwork for the design function to grow around you.

You'll partner directly with the Founder & CEO and the Director of Product on the vision for the company and the product, and work closely with the Product Managers on Clasp Talent and leaders in Marketing, Partner Success, and Engineering to bring it to life.

What You’ll Do

  • Define Design and Brand at Clasp: Own the visual identity, design language, and standard of taste across the company. Make the foundational decisions about how Clasp looks and feels — and set the bar everyone else builds toward.

  • Own the Full Experience, Product to Marketing Site: Design across consumer acquisition flows, the marketing site, recruiter platforms, employee benefits experiences, and employer admin tooling — moving fluidly between brand-led marketing surfaces and operations-heavy fintech workflows so the whole journey feels like one product.

  • Own and Evolve the Design System: Take ownership of our existing design system — maturing components, patterns, and principles so they scale with the company. Evolve what's working, and if you believe a deeper rethink is warranted, make the case for it. Either way, you own the standard everyone builds toward.

  • Shape Product Direction, Not Just Execution: Bring a strong point of view to what we build and why, not only how it looks. Partner with the founder and Product on strategy, framing problems and proposing directions rather than waiting for fully specified requirements.

  • Make Complex Workflows Feel Simple: Bring clarity to the genuinely hard surfaces — HRIS integration setup, flow-of-funds visibility, invoice and credit reconciliation, benefit administration. Make data-rich, compliance-sensitive interfaces feel calm, legible, and trustworthy.

  • Get Close to Users: Partner with Product to run qualitative and quantitative research — usability testing, interviews, data-driven insights. Spend real time with healthcare students, recruiters, employees, and employer-administrators, and translate that contact into design decisions.

  • Elevate the Craft: Raise the bar for clarity, quality, and cohesion across everything Clasp ships. Healthcare students deciding whether to commit to an employer, and employees relying on this benefit to repay their loans, are making meaningful career and financial decisions; the experience should reflect that gravity while removing every unnecessary friction.

  • Infuse Delight and Personality: Introduce moments of engagement, warmth, and humanity that make the product feel trustworthy and memorable, not transactional — even (especially) on the operational surfaces.

  • Leverage AI Workflows: Explore and responsibly apply emerging AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and design production — making your process smarter, faster, and more scalable.

What You’ll Need

  • Principal-Level Design Experience: 8+ years of product design experience, including time spent setting design direction — not just executing within someone else's system. You've owned the visual language, brand, or design practice for a product or company, and have the case studies to show how you did it.

  • Strategic Range: You think beyond the screen. You can hold the company's goals in your head, form a point of view on what matters, and make foundational calls about brand and product identity with limited direction.

  • Brand and Product Fluency: Comfort moving between brand-led marketing surfaces (a marketing site, a landing page, a campaign) and data-dense product tooling (an invoice reconciliation screen, an admin dashboard) — and bringing craft to both.

  • Systems Thinking: Ability to hold a large, interconnected ecosystem in your head and design experiences that scale. You understand how a change in one persona's flow ripples across the others, and you build systems, not one-offs.

  • Design System Ownership: You've owned or substantially shaped a production design system — evolving components, patterns, and principles, and balancing flexibility with consistency as a product grows. You know when to refine what exists and when to argue for a rebuild.

  • Strong Visual Craft: A refined sense of typography, layout, color, and visual hierarchy, with awareness of modern product aesthetics and the instinct for when to break convention.

  • Fluency in Figma: Deep experience with components, variables, auto layout, and prototyping. You understand how your designs map to code and collaborate effectively with engineers.

  • Multi-Persona Product Sensibility: Comfort designing for products with multiple distinct user types — where each persona has different goals, contexts, and constraints. Bonus if you've worked on products where the user and the customer aren't the same person.

  • Research Competency: Comfort partnering with Product on qualitative and quantitative research — usability tests, interviews, analytics reviews — and incorporating insights into your design process.

  • AI Curiosity: Hands-on experience experimenting with AI tools in your workflow, and excitement about applying them responsibly to accelerate output and explore new interaction models.

  • Remote Collaboration: You're effective working remotely with a distributed team. You're proactive about communication, comfortable shaping ideas in writing as well as in real time, and willing to travel occasionally for in-person sessions when it matters.

  • Healthcare, health-tech, fintech, or HR-tech experience is a plus but not required.

What We Give In Return

  • Competitive cash and equity compensation

  • Health benefits (health, dental, & vision)

  • Student loan repayment benefits

  • 401k matching

  • Commuter benefits

  • Flexible PTO policy

  • Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environment alongside a stellar team

Salary

The salary range for this position is competitive and will be commensurate with the candidate's experience, qualifications, and industry knowledge, ranging between $155,000 to $190,000 annually. In addition to the base salary, we offer an attractive equity component as part of our compensation package, providing an opportunity for eligible employees to share in the success and growth of our company. We are committed to offering competitive compensation and benefits packages to attract and retain top talent.

Remote Policy

To ensure smooth collaboration with the Boston-based team, we are limiting to Eastern/Central timezones with the expectation that it will be Boston hours. Additionally, they must be within 1 hour of a medium hub/ large airport with multiple daily flights to Boston. We are targeting the broader New England area to start as we expect that the candidate to have frequent travel to Boston for onboarding and ongoing collaboration.

Closing

If you are a senior designer who cares about craft, thinks in systems, and wants to anchor design for a mission-driven company at a real inflection point, we want to hear from you. Join us in connecting healthcare students with meaningful careers and the financial benefits that change their lives.

We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all employees feel valued, respected, and empowered to contribute their unique perspectives and talents. Clasp is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We embrace diversity and are dedicated to providing equal employment opportunities to all individuals regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

clutch-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

Clutch is expanding its design team. We're looking for a Product Designer to craft intuitive, human-centered experiences that power our lending and loan-application workflows.

This isn't surface-level screen design. You'll work across the full service — the borrower applying, the credit union employee processing the application, and the legacy systems and compliance steps in between. The wins here come from designing end-to-end processes, not just polishing individual screens: simplifying genuinely complex workflows, clarifying high-stakes financial information, and making every step feel effortless and trustworthy.

You'll move fast, own your work, and know when to drive a decision yourself versus when to pull in your PM and engineering partners. And you won't live only in Figma: our designers use AI to prototype, explore, and design — and to ship code for simpler features themselves. AI is core to how this team works and what we build, and we want someone eager to push that further.

About the Team

At Clutch, design isn't just a department — it's the driving force behind our mission. We believe a seamless user experience can empower credit unions to compete and offer superior banking to everyday people. By crafting intuitive experiences, we help credit unions guide their members toward financial freedom.

Our growing design team is fully remote in the U.S. and Brazil. It is diverse, collaborative, ambitious, and empowered to take on our company's biggest challenges.

What You’ll Do

Within 1 Month, you will:

  • Get oriented fast: Build a strong working understanding of Clutch's lending products, the borrower and operator journeys, and the compliance and legacy-system realities they sit inside, quickly enough to start contributing.

  • Build relationships and credibility: Establish yourself with the product managers, engineers, and credit union partners you'll work with, and start earning trust as a design leader on the team.

  • Get hands-on with AI: Ramp on Clutch's AI design tooling and practices, using AI to prototype and explore from week one.

Within 3 Months, you will:

  • Own a significant area end to end: Take a large, loosely-defined design project from discovery through delivery, defining the problem and scoping the work yourself.

  • Design & ship real flows: Lead design on a substantial piece of the loan-application experience, reducing friction for borrowers and operators alike.

  • Build, not just mock: Use AI to create working prototypes, and ship simpler production changes yourself in partnership with engineering.

  • Drive clarity through research: Run interviews, concept tests, and usability sessions to validate your decisions, and bring the insights back to your partners.

Within 6 Months, you will:

  • Think in systems: Map full workflows (handoffs, compliance touchpoints, edge cases) and design reusable, scalable patterns rather than one-off screens.

  • Own a critical, high-stakes workflow: Lead design end to end for a core part of the lending journey (e.g., intake or decisioning), including the ambiguity and cross-team dependencies that come with it.

  • Shape direction, not just execution: Bring research and data into roadmap and prioritization conversations, influencing what the team builds and why.

  • Raise the bar on team craft: Drive design critique, share what you're learning about AI-assisted workflows, and help improve process and documentation across the team.

  • Collaborate with judgment: Partner closely with PMs and engineers as a true thought partner, knowing when to run independently and when to bring partners in to turn user and business needs into production-ready designs.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience: 6-8 years as a product designer, with a track record in fintech, SaaS, or other complex, workflow-heavy environments.

  • AI appetite and fluency: Genuinely excited about AI in design and already putting it to work, using AI to prototype, design, and ship simpler features rather than stopping at static Figma mockups. You'll help set the bar for how the team designs with AI.

  • Service and systems design: Designs confidently across an end-to-end process (multi-step flows, multiple user types like a borrower and a back-office operator, handoffs, and edge cases) and brings structure to ambiguous, loosely defined problem spaces.

  • Craft: Excellent visual and interaction design skills, setting a high bar for clear, elegant solutions to multi-step, data-heavy experiences.

  • User empathy: Skilled at uncovering user needs through research and turning them into design decisions, and at advocating for those needs in roadmap and prioritization conversations.

  • Partnership judgment: Works fluidly with PMs and engineers as a true thought partner, with strong instincts for when to move autonomously and when to pull partners in.

  • Autonomy and ownership: Can own large, ambiguous projects end to end, define the problem, scope the work, cut scope sensibly, and drive it to ship without close direction.

  • Influence and communication: Excellent storytelling, documentation, and presentation skills; explains both the design outcome and the reasoning, and shapes the thinking of partners and stakeholders around them.

  • Comfort with complexity: Patience and pragmatism working inside regulated workflows, legacy tooling, and real-world constraints, plus the temperament to find those problems interesting.

  • Elevates the team: Strengthens the craft around them through design critique, mentorship, and improvements to process and documentation.

Please note that this role may evolve as our business needs change, so we appreciate your flexibility and adaptability.

What’s In It For You?

  • Remote Flexibility: Enjoy the freedom of remote work from anywhere, balancing life and career seamlessly.

  • Unforgettable Off-Sites: Twice a year, bond with colleagues in exciting destinations, fostering teamwork and fresh ideas.

  • Paid Time Off: Enjoy flexible PTO days yearly for relaxation and rejuvenation.

  • Stock Options: Joining us means having a stake in our success, so you'll receive stock options as part of your compensation package.

  • Home Office Setup: Create your ideal workspace with a dedicated budget for home office essentials.

  • Work Trip Budget: Grow personally and professionally with a budget for work-related trips and co-working.

  • Health Coverage: Prioritize your well-being with comprehensive health and dental insurance plans.

About Us

Clutch is a revolutionary vertical SaaS company, proudly backed by Andreessen Horowitz (A16z), aimed at revolutionizing the way Credit Unions engage and change the lives of their members. As a champion of financial well-being, we address the urgent need for affordable lending solutions in an era where the average American grapples with over $155,000 in household debt. Unlike traditional financial institutions, Clutch develops software to turn Credit Unions into FinTech lenders and leverage their balance sheets to responsibly lend to over 130M Americans. Our mission extends beyond mere financial transactions; we strive to fundamentally enhance the way credit unions interact with their members. By integrating cutting-edge technologies and user-centric designs, we help credit unions provide seamless digital experiences that are on par with leading tech companies. This approach not only preserves but revitalizes the longstanding tradition of community and member-focused service inherent to credit unions.

Clutch is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Our organization participates in E-Verify. Click here to learn about E-Verify.

credal-founding-design-engineer.descriptionHtml:
About us

Our mission at Credal is to harness frontier AI for everyone building a better future.

We accelerate the most complex, sophisticated operations of the most impactful institutions, while weaving security and governance into every part of our product. Our customers include the U.S. Dept of Health and Human Services, MongoDB, Comcast NBC Universal, Lattice, Wise (Transferwise), Checkr, and incident.io among others.

We’ve raised over $10m to date with a ton of runway. You’ll join a team of Thoughtful Doers™ from places like Palantir, Cruise, Meta, Uber, and Google.

📍 Credal is in-person in our spacious NYC office with meals provided.

This role

We're looking for the person who will define what design means at Credal. You'll be the first design hire and you'll own the function.

Credal sits on top of some of the most complex and important machinery in enterprise software: permission inheritance across a thousand data sources, agent registries, governance policy, audit lineage. And we're building it on the frontier of AI, where the conventions for how any of this should look and feel haven't been established yet; so there's real room to explore and define them across the industry. Our customers include some of the most important institutions in the world, and we're actively relied on every day by thousands of employees at customers like HHS, Flatiron Health, Comcast, and Wise.

Today, our engineering is ahead of our storytelling. The gap between what we've built and how clearly a user grasps it in the first thirty seconds is the single highest-leverage problem we can hand to one person. That's this role.

What you'll own

  • Translate company strategy and user needs into visual language. Concretely, that means product UI and user stories. You turn a go-to-market bet into something people immediately understand.

  • Own and evolve the design system. The rules, components, patterns, and principles that allow our engineering team to iterate quickly without sacrificing legibility.

  • Author front-end code within reason. Enough to build and maintain the design system in code, prototype your own ideas, and ship polish without waiting in an eng queue. You won't carry a backend load (unless you're interested); we have a full team for that.

The honest split

This role is roughly 70% design, 30% code. We have a full team for feature development, but you'll need to be self-sufficient prototyping and able to iterate on frontend-specific production changes yourself. If you're a brilliant designer who codes enough to be dangerous, you're exactly who we want; if you're an engineer who dabbles in design, this probably isn't your seat.

You'll thrive here if

  • You think in systems. You understand user needs deeply enough to turn them into reusable patterns. The kind that act as a force multiplier on the whole team rather than a one-off fix.

  • You can sit with our users and the team, synthesize strategy, and come back with a visual story that makes it land.

  • You have strong, defensible opinions about type, layout, motion, and information density.

  • Enterprise, technical, developer-facing product excites rather than bores you. Making the complicated feel simple is the whole job.

  • You want the range and ownership that only exist at a small company.

Benefits and work environment

  • Opportunity to take ownership and accountability of major mission, business and technical outcomes from day one. Exercise your full capacity to create positive change in the world, rather than waiting for permission to advance to slightly less boring tickets or tasks.

  • High quality health coverage, including great mental health benefits, for you and your immediate family. This includes comprehensive and HSA options.

  • Industry-leading vision, dental, life, disability coverage.

  • Regular team activities & offsite events (last year we went to Turks and Caicos for a hackathon week!)

  • Unlimited PTO - and unlike some other companies, we're serious about you taking the time you need to recharge and be the best you can be! We also offer a guaranteed two weeks off during the last two weeks of December when the entire company goes on vacation!

  • A generous housing subsidy for those who choose to live close to the office.

Interview process

  • Intro conversation with our leadership team (CEO, COO, CTO depending on the role).

  • Virtual screen.

  • Onsite to meet our team and CEO.

  • References (we check references on everyone at Credal to make sure all your future coworkers are world class and great to be around).

More about us

We’ve built the industry’s highest ceiling and most secure Action & Agent building platform for sticky, custom AI workflows. Use cases span countless domains, including: KYC, anti-money laundering, healthcare regulation, climate standards setting, cybersecurity, sales, people, IT, and customer support.

  • Cultural principles

  • Team of 13 with 9 engineers.

  • 7-figure ARR.

  • >100% NRR.

  • Product docs, case studies, blog, podcast

cyble-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a Product Designer with 3 to 5 years of experience who brings rigorous UX craft and a clear-headed approach to designing under complexity.

In this role, you will own the end-to-end design of product experiences across security dashboards, investigation workflows, and data-intensive interfaces. You will work directly with Product Managers, Engineers, and stakeholders to translate high-stakes security scenarios into interfaces that are precise, trustworthy, and efficient.

This is an individual contributor role. You will be expected to operate with a high degree of ownership, bring a structured design process, and contribute actively to our design system and AI-powered product surfaces.

What You’ll Do at Cyble:

User Research and Strategic Insight

  • Plan and conduct user research including contextual interviews, task analysis, and heuristic evaluations tailored to security-focused user personas such as SOC Analysts, Threat Intelligence Analysts, and CISOs.
  • Synthesize research into structured artifacts including personas, journey maps, and friction logs that directly inform product prioritization and design direction.
  • Collaborate with Product Leads to align design strategy with business objectives and user expectations across enterprise security workflows.

UX and Interaction Design

  • Design end-to-end workflows for complex, multi-step security processes including alert triage, investigation flows, threat correlation, and risk reporting.
  • Create user flows, wireframes, and high-fidelity interactive prototypes that communicate interaction logic clearly to both stakeholders and engineering teams.
  • Design for all UI states including loading, empty, error, partial data, and real-time update conditions that are common in live security platforms.
  • Apply strong information architecture principles to organize high-density dashboards and data-rich interfaces without sacrificing usability or clarity.
  • Iterate rapidly based on usability testing, design reviews, and engineering feedback.

AI-Native Feature Design

  • Design product experiences that incorporate AI-generated insights, contextual recommendations, and automated correlation across security data.
  • Define UX patterns for AI surfaces including confidence indicators, explainability panels, fallback states, and progressive disclosure of AI-driven analysis.
  • Understand and apply guardrail principles for AI features in high-stakes security contexts, ensuring that automated outputs are presented with appropriate trust signals and user control.
  • Use AI tools actively in your own design workflow to accelerate research synthesis, generate copy and interaction variants, and explore layout alternatives efficiently.

Interface Design and Visual Consistency

  • Deliver production-ready, visually consistent interface designs that comply with established brand guidelines and design system standards.
  • Balance visual clarity with functional density, ensuring every interface element earns its place and supports decision-making under cognitive load.
  • Apply accessibility standards including WCAG 2.1 AA compliance across all design work, ensuring interfaces are inclusive for diverse user profiles.

Design System Contribution

  • Work fluently within a token-based design system, applying semantic color, spacing, and typography tokens consistently across components.
  • Contribute new components, usage guidelines, and documentation back to the design system in a structured and reviewable format.
  • Identify gaps or inconsistencies in the system and raise them through the appropriate contribution process, collaborating with the UX Lead to resolve them.

Usability Testing and Continuous Improvement

  • Plan and conduct usability testing sessions with representative user personas, including time-pressured scenarios that reflect real security incident conditions.
  • Translate behavioral observations and product analytics into actionable friction maps and design improvements.
  • Maintain a rigorous feedback loop across design, product, and engineering to ensure shipped features reflect validated design intent.

Collaboration and Engineering Handoff

  • Partner with Product Managers, Engineers, Customer Success Managers, and Sales to align design decisions with technical feasibility, customer needs, and business context.
  • Produce engineering-ready design specifications in Figma including annotated components, interaction notes, responsive behavior, and edge case handling.
  • Participate in sprint ceremonies, design reviews, and cross-team critiques to maintain shared understanding and design continuity across workstreams.
  • Communicate design rationale and user insights clearly to stakeholders across technical and non-technical backgrounds.

What You’ll Need:

  1. 3 to 5 years of experience as a Product Designer with a strong portfolio spanning research, interaction design, and visual delivery
  2. Demonstrated ability to design for data-intensive, complex enterprise products with multiple user personas
  3. Proficiency in Figma including component creation, auto-layout, prototyping, and engineering handoff, and Claude for AI-assisted design research, ideation, and workflow acceleration
  4. Solid understanding of UX principles, usability heuristics, and human-centered design methodology
  5. Experience contributing to or working within a structured design system
  6. Ability to design all interface states including real-time, empty, error, loading, and partial data conditions
  7. Familiarity with AI-powered features and the UX patterns required to present them clearly and responsibly
  8. Strong communication skills with the ability to present and defend design decisions to cross-functional stakeholders
  9. Experience in agile, cross-functional product teams with structured sprint and review cycles

Bonus Points If You Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Design, HCI, Information Design, Visual Communication, or a related field
  • Prior experience designing for cybersecurity, enterprise software, or B2B SaaS platforms
  • Experience designing for WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility standards
  • Familiarity with token-based design systems and component governance
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate design research, ideation, or iteration workflows
  • Understanding of front-end development constraints and ability to collaborate closely with engineers on implementation

If you like working in an inclusive environment, you want to advance your career quickly, and your opinion is valued, look no further than Cyble, Inc. We are young, hungry, and ready to impact the cyber security landscape!

Cyble, Inc. takes into consideration an individual’s skillset, experience and location in making final salary determination.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected Veteran status age, or genetics, or any other characteristic protected by law.

deel-lead-product-designer-fintech.descriptionHtml:
Who we are is what we do.

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. Our vision is to unlock global opportunity for every person, team, and business. Built for the way the world works today, Deel combines HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance, and equipment management into one seamless platform. With AI-powered tools and a fully owned payroll infrastructure, Deel supports every worker type in 150+ countries—helping businesses scale smarter, faster, and more compliantly.

Among the largest globally distributed companies in the world, our team of 7,000 spans more than 100 countries, speaks 74 languages, and brings a connected and dynamic culture that drives continuous learning and innovation for our customers.

Why should you be part of our success story?

As the fastest-growing Software as a Service (SaaS) company in history, Deel is transforming how global talent connects with world-class companies – breaking down borders that have traditionally limited both hiring and career opportunities. We're not just building software; we're creating the infrastructure for the future of work, enabling a more diverse and inclusive global economy. In 2024 alone, we paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits to workers in 109 countries—ensuring people get paid and protected, no matter where they are.

Our momentum is reflected in our achievements and customer satisfaction: CNBC Disruptor 50, Forbes Cloud 100, Deloitte Fast 500, and repeated recognition on Y Combinator’s top companies list – all while maintaining a 4.83 average rating from 15,000 reviews across G2, Trustpilot, Captera, Apple and Google.

Your experience at Deel will be a career accelerator. At the forefront of the global work revolution, you'll tackle complex challenges that impact millions of people's working lives. With our momentum—backed by a $17.3 billion valuation and $1 B in Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) in just over five years—you'll drive meaningful impact while building expertise that makes you a sought-after leader in the transformation of global work.

Summary

We’re hiring a hands-on Design Leader to join our Fintech design team. Deel Fintech mission is to build the best experience in the world for paying and getting paid — globally, compliantly, instantly — as part of Deel’s all-in-one platform for hiring, managing, and paying talent.

You’ll own design across our most visible Client and Worker experiences on Web and Mobile — touching products used daily by hundreds of thousands of businesses and millions of workers worldwide.

We’re looking for someone who gets deep into product work, has a strong doer mindset, thinks big, and moves fast. This is a different kind of leadership. Not decks, not endless strategy debates, not big-org politics. It’s about leading by doing. Setting the bar. Shipping strong work. Raising others through example.

It’s a hybrid role: you’ll lead a small team and still design yourself.

What you’ll do

  • ~30% Vision. Partnering with PDE Directors to shape where Client and Worker experiences should go next. Connecting dots across journeys. Rethinking the existing paradigms. Challenging the status quo.

  • ~40% Operator mode. Working directly with designers on active B2B and B2C projects. Tightening UX. Solving complexity. Raising quality in real time.

  • ~30% Team leadership. Managing and developing a small team through hands-on collaboration. Creating clarity. Raising the bar. Putting them first.

What we’re looking for

  • 8+ years in Product Design, 3+ years operating at a very senior IC level (Lead / Staff)

  • At least 2+ years managing designers

  • AI: Curiosity about AI and emerging technologies; experience designing AI-assisted or AI-powered product experiences or using AI tools as part of your design workflow. A portfolio that includes examples of work related to AI-powered features, AI-assisted workflows, or experiments with AI tools.

  • Experience in fast-moving product companies (scale-ups, strong tech orgs, fintech, neo-banks)

  • Strong craft across interaction and visual design

  • Comfortable across B2B and consumer experiences

  • Solid mobile experience

  • Fintech experience is a plus

You should be someone who:

  • Thrives in velocity

  • Doesn't wait for perfect clarity

  • Makes good decisions under pressure

  • Puts the team first

  • Holds a high bar for yourself and for others

  • Cares about details and outcomes

Design & AI at Deel
