ivo-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Why Join Ivo?

Every civilization runs on the same infrastructure: agreements between people who don't fully trust each other. Sumerians pressed them into clay. Romans carved them into stone. We bury them in 80-page PDFs.

The way those agreements are reviewed hasn't changed in four thousand years - a human reads the whole thing and tries not to miss anything. We're building the AI that finally changes that. Ivo is the contract intelligence platform of choice for companies like Uber, Meta, Canva, IBM, and Shopify. We recently raised our Series B and have grown 800% over the last 12 months.

The Opportunity

We are looking for an exceptional designer to join our team in San Francisco. You will guide the vision, strategy, and execution of Ivo’s design system while managing a small team of designers. You will work across Product and Engineering to build a system that elevates product teams, one that enables rapid iteration without sacrificing coherence, taste, or craft.

What You’ll Do

  • Create, maintain, and scale component libraries, design tokens, interaction patterns, and accessibility standards

  • Define and own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Ivo’s design system.

  • Partner closely with Engineering to ensure system adoption, alignment, and implementation quality of the design system

  • Develop workflows that improve designer and developer collaboration, such as Figma libraries, documentation, and quality checks

  • Shape internal best practices for design documentation, guidelines, and cross-team collaboration

  • Constantly raise the bar for design craft and execution

What You'll Bring:

  • 4+ years of experience in product design

  • Experience building design systems for SaaS platforms

  • Deep expertise in Figma, component libraries, tokens, variants, and systematic file organization

  • Constantly learning and adapting to the rapid changes AI brings to UI/UX

  • A proclivity to adopting and experimenting intelligently with AI tools

  • Strong communication and documentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate system rationale and implementation guidance

  • Experience operating in a fast-paced environment with multiple priorities and high expectations for craft

  • A portfolio that demonstrates how you’ve shaped scalable design patterns, systematized complex UI challenges, and delivered cohesive experiences

Ivo might be a good fit for you if you:

  • Would describe yourself as being relentlessly resourceful.

  • You have a strong internal sense of urgency. You have a bias towards doing things today, rather than tomorrow.

  • Experience working in a startup environment is preferred but not required.

  • Are excited about the adventure of building a company!

What We Offer

  • Competitive Compensation: Final offer details are determined based on experience, expertise, and overall fit.

  • Equity: Meaningful ownership in a company that's scaling fast

  • Relocation and Visa Support: We also offer relocation assistance for successful applicants moving to SF, as well as support for visa and green card applications where applicable.

  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision plans to suit the needs of you and your family.

  • Flexible Spending & Insurance: Access to HSA and FSA accounts, plus life insurance coverage.

  • 401(k) Program: Save for the future with our 401(k) program.

  • Commuter Benefits: We help make getting to and from the office easier and more convenient.

  • Unlimited PTO: So you can take the time you need to recharge, stay healthy, and bring your best self to work.

  • Office Perks: Enjoy a vibrant Downtown San Francisco office with catered lunch five days a week, premium snacks and coffee, an in-building gym, and a dog-friendly environment.

FAQ

  • What stage of growth is Ivo at?: We launched in early access in 2023. Since then, we’ve had an incredible response from the market and are growing rapidly. We 6x'd in ARR in the last 12 months. Our clients include companies like Uber, Reddit, IBM, Canva, Pinterest, WordPress, and more. We're happy to share more details with candidates who go through our interview process.

  • Is this a chill gig?: Startups are very hard, especially if they’re growing fast. You’ll have a ton of responsibility, and there’s always an enormous amount of stuff to do. It’s hard work but the payoff is uncapped.

  • Can I work remotely?: We require candidates to work with us in-person 5 days a week in our San Francisco office.

Ivo is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jeeves-senior-designer.descriptionHtml:
Jeeves is a groundbreaking financial operating system built for global businesses that provides corporate cards, cross-border payments, and spend management software within one unified platform. The company operates across 20+ countries including Brazil, Canada, Colombia, Mexico, the United Kingdom, across Europe, and the United States, and serves over 5,000 clients ranging from venture-backed startups to SMBs around the world. With a mission to empower businesses with more efficient and cost-effective financial solutions worldwide, Jeeves combines cutting-edge financial technology with exceptional team expertise to transform the business financial landscape. Jeeves has been recognized as one of The Information's 50 Most Promising Startups in 2023, as well as a Y Combinator Top Company 2021-2023 and won “Fintech of the Year" at the European Fintech Awards.

Since graduating from Y Combinator in 2020, Jeeves has successfully raised over $380 million and is backed by top world-class investors including Andreessen Horowitz, Y Combinator, CRV, Tencent, Stanford University, Clocktower Ventures, and founders of more than 15 unicorns including David Velez (Nubank), Carlos Garcia (Kavak) and Sebastián Mejía (Rappi).

Jeeves has grown fast, and our core product — cards, cross-border payments, and spend management — now serves thousands of businesses across three continents. That growth has outpaced the consistency and craft of our core user experience. We’re hiring a Senior Product Designer to change that: to raise the bar on quality, coherence, and usability across the flows our customers touch every day.

You’ll own design for our core product surfaces end to end — from discovery and research through shipped, measured outcomes — working directly with product leadership, PMs, and engineers. You’ll be the voice of the customer in a payments platform with real complexity: multiple currencies, multiple countries, and finance teams who depend on us to get it right. Our Design team’s mission is to provide a voice of empathy and develop the most engaging user experiences within the Jeeves product, and this role is at the center of that mission.

This is a hands-on senior IC role, not a management position. You’ll operate with high autonomy inside a globally distributed team — we’re looking for someone who moves work forward independently, not someone who needs a design manager to set direction. Jeeves is an AI-forward company, and we expect our designers to work that way too: using AI tools daily to explore more directions, prototype earlier, and synthesize research faster — and helping define what AI-assisted design looks like at Jeeves.

Location : This role is a full-time remote position. #LI-REMOTE

What You’ll Do:

  • Product Design

    • Design across the full Jeeves platform, from mobile to desktop, with a focus on our core card, payments, and spend management flows

    • Own projects end to end: framing the problem, exploring solutions, shipping with engineering, and measuring outcomes

    • Elevate the craft and consistency of the core product experience — identify UX debt and drive a plan to pay it down

    • Promote the product vision through design exploration, documentation, and presentations to leadership

    • Use AI tools throughout your workflow — generative exploration, AI prototyping, and LLM-assisted copy and documentation — to test more directions faster without sacrificing craft

    • Apply payments and fintech domain expertise to design for real-world financial complexity, including AI-powered product experiences within Jeeves (intelligent expense review, automation, insights)

      • Design Systems

      • Use and extend Jeeves’s existing design system and standards

      • Identify gaps and inconsistencies across product surfaces — using AI tooling to audit at scale — and drive systematic fixes

      • Establish design principles and patterns that other designers and engineers can build on, including patterns for AI-driven features (confidence, explainability, human review)

        • Research & Validation

        • Plan and run your own research — including personally recruiting participants when needed

        • Use AI to accelerate research synthesis and analysis — while keeping human judgment on what customers actually need

        • Validate design decisions with customers before and after shipping

        • Advocate the customer perspective across Jeeves, grounded in evidence

          • Cross-Functional Collaboration

          • Partner daily with product managers, engineers, UX researchers, and product marketers

          • Create and collaborate on the product vision with core product leadership, reporting directly into it

          • Influence design practices and team operations within a distributed, global team — including how the design team adopts AI in its workflows

          • Participate in cross-functional interviews and help raise the design bar in hiring

Minimum Requirements:

    • 5+ years of professional product design experience, with senior-level scope on multiple high-impact projects you were directly responsible for

    • Experience designing for fintech, payments, or financial services products

    • A portfolio demonstrating end-to-end ownership: problem framing, exploration, shipped outcomes — not just final screens

    • Demonstrated ability to drive projects forward independently in ambiguous environments, without heavy direction

    • Working fluency with AI tools in your design process — demonstrated by how you actually use them today for exploration, prototyping, research synthesis, or documentation (be ready to show this, not just name tools)

    • Experience working within and improving design systems at scale

    • Hands-on research experience, including recruiting your own participants and synthesizing findings into design decisions

    • Track record of close collaboration with PM and Engineering through to shipped product

    • Professional working proficiency in English

Preferred Qualifications:

    • Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem — networks, issuers, partners, and how platforms like Jeeves differentiate within it

    • Experience designing for B2B or finance-team users (controllers, CFOs, ops teams)

    • Experience designing AI-powered product experiences — copilots, agents, or intelligent automation — especially patterns for trust, explainability, and human oversight in financial products

    • Experience working in a globally distributed product organization across time zones

    • Experience mentoring other designers or shaping design team practices

    • Native or professional English and Spanish, Portuguese preferred

jinba-founding-design-engineer.descriptionHtml:
Design engineer who owns the full visual and interactive experience of Jinba's platform. You'll build our design system from the ground up, create motion that makes complex workflows feel intuitive, and ship production code alongside the engineering team. This is a founding design role for someone who wants to shape how enterprise users interact with AI-native software.

Responsibilities

  • Design and build Jinba's design system: components, tokens, patterns, and documentation
  • Own UI/UX for core product surfaces, from concept through implementation
  • Create motion design that guides users through workflow creation and execution
  • Write clean, maintainable frontend code (we use shadcn/ui and modern React patterns)
  • Collaborate directly with engineering to ship features, not just hand off specs
  • Establish design processes and standards as the first dedicated design hire

Requirements

Design Skills

  • Strong product design sense with portfolio showing end-to-end ownership
  • Experience building or significantly contributing to a design system
  • Motion design ability: you understand timing, easing, and how animation communicates state

Technical Ability

  • Proficient in React/TypeScript; you ship your own designs
  • Familiar with component libraries like shadcn/ui, Radix, or similar
  • Understanding of design tokens, CSS architecture, and scalable frontend patterns

Product Context

  • Experience with developer tools, no-code platforms, or workflow/automation products
  • Comfort designing complex interfaces: canvas editors, drag-and-drop builders, multi-step flows
  • Ability to simplify dense functionality without dumbing it down

Strong Signals

  • Design engineer or founding designer roles at early-stage startups
  • Experience at companies like Figma, Linear, Notion, Retool, Vercel, or similar dev/productivity tools
  • Built a design system from scratch at a growing company
  • Background combining design and engineering

Mindset

  • Generalist: you'd rather own the whole surface than perfect one component forever
  • Opinionated but collaborative: you have strong taste and can articulate why
  • Early-stage ready: you're excited by ambiguity and building foundations others will use

jito-foundation-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
JTX is our trading app, and it runs on the fastest market infrastructure on Solana, which we also built. It’s live today, self-custodial, and native mobile apps are in development.

We’re looking for a Product Designer to focus mainly on JTX, but you’ll also have the chance to help with other Jito products as needed.

We’re a small team and have already found product-market fit. This shapes the way we work:

  • You’ll make real decisions, not just work through a backlog set by others.

  • We release features and learn from real user feedback, rather than getting stuck in endless debates.

  • Attention to detail is essential here. For a trading product, the small things make all the difference.

About the Position

You’ll work on UX and UI for both web and native mobile. Right now, our main challenge is making JTX feel clear and trustworthy at a glance, not just functional. You’ll also help keep things consistent between web and mobile, and pitch in on marketing design when needed.

You’ll work closely with engineering and product to make the most important decisions. If you’ve ever thought about how traders read a screen under pressure and want to create the product layer that makes speed tangible, this could be the right fit for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Design for JTX across web and mobile, including order entry, market data, charts, positions, execution visibility, onboarding, and wallet flows.

  • Take features from defining the problem through UX and final UI.

  • Own and improve the design system and token library that our engineers use.

  • Help with marketing design when needed, like landing pages, social assets, and launch materials.

  • Jump in on design work for other Jito products when the team needs extra help.

  • Release, observe real usage, and keep improving.

Requirements

  • Strong product sense: you can explain why a decision is right, not just that it looks good.

  • You can spot issues with hierarchy and clarity on a busy screen and explain what’s causing them.

  • You’re comfortable working across research, UX, and UI, just like any early-stage product designer needs to.

  • You can work independently and bring the team in on important decisions, but not every single one.

  • You’re a true collaborator who communicates proactively and works well with engineering and product.

  • You’re comfortable giving direct feedback on others’ work and receiving it on your own. Here, critique is quick and specific, never personal.

  • You’re fluent in Figma and comfortable working directly with token-based design systems.

Preferred (not required)

  • Experience designing consumer (B2C) crypto or fintech products, or hands-on experience as a trader.

  • Trading terminals, exchange or brokerage products.

  • Consumer fintech apps at scale.

  • Data-dense or real-time interfaces, such as dashboards, analytics, or live data visualization.

  • Self-custodial wallets, Solana or EVM products.

  • Experience building or maintaining a token-based design system.

juniper-square-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

We are looking for an experienced and autonomous Senior Product Designer to join our team, embedded within a core product squad with broad scope across our platform. This is a high-impact individual contributor role where you will own the end-to-end user experience for your product area, drive meaningful contributions to our design system, and partner closely with product managers and engineers to ship work that makes a real difference for our customers.

AI fluency is a baseline expectation. Designers at this level should be comfortable across the full range of modern design tools, including AI. That might mean starting in an LLM to frame a problem, building a quick prototype in Cursor or Claude Code to explore an interaction, or going to Figma to produce a polished developer reference. The expectation is sound judgment about what will get to the best outcome for the customer and the team.

What you'll do

Own the Work End to End Produce work in whatever form best serves the team and engineering, whether that's annotated flows, coded prototypes, LLM-generated specs with design system context loaded, or Figma files when a polished developer reference is needed. When handing off to engineering, ensure files are complete, accurate, and consistent with our design system. The starting point matters less than the outcome: your output should reflect the kind of judgment and taste that distinguishes considered design from generated templates.

Simplify Complexity Take on hard problems in your product domain and deliver solutions that feel simple. Our users work with sophisticated financial data and workflows. The complexity lives in the craft, not the interface.

Design for AI-Driven Features Contribute to the UX of AI-powered capabilities across our product suite, including proactive recommendations, generative summaries, and predictive insights. Get the trust and transparency details right so these features feel reliable to enterprise customers, not like a black box.

Generate and Apply Insights Conduct research and interpret product analytics to uncover real user needs and measure the impact of your designs. Talk directly with customers, run quick tests, and treat research as a velocity tool rather than a gate.

Lead Cross-Functional Collaboration Partner with product managers, engineers, and stakeholders to align on strategy and ensure design execution serves both the business and the user. Own the design relationship with your product area end to end.

Strengthen the Design System Continuously improve and expand our design system, advocating for consistency and pattern reuse across the product suite. Collaborate with peers on the design team to give and receive feedback, raising the collective craft of the organization.

Qualifications

Required

  • 4+ years of professional experience as a Product Designer, with a meaningful portfolio of shipped work across the full development lifecycle.

  • Proven experience designing for a complex B2B or Enterprise SaaS product, ideally in a data-heavy domain.

  • Fluency with modern design and prototyping tools. Figma proficiency is expected, including experience with component libraries, auto-layout, and developer-ready handoff files. Comfort with AI-powered tools (LLMs, Cursor, Claude Code) is equally important, even if you are not writing production code.

  • Experience designing for AI/ML-driven features with strong attention to trust, explainability, and error states.

  • Demonstrated ability to operate autonomously and deliver high-quality work without requiring significant direction.

  • Strong communication skills, written, verbal, and visual, with the ability to clearly articulate design decisions to engineers, PMs, and executives alike.

  • A portfolio that showcases deep UX thinking, clear user journeys, and a high degree of visual polish.

Preferred

  • Experience contributing to or maintaining a multi-platform design system, including pattern documentation and component creation.

  • Background in Financial Services, Investment Management, Real Estate, or adjacent industries.

  • A track record of designing complex tables, filters, and data visualization tools.

  • Experience planning and running customer interviews or usability tests.

  • Based in the SF Bay Area to facilitate in-person collaboration with local teams.

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity, and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $148,000 to $185,000 USD. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including seniority, skillset, location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable. Your recruiter can provide further details.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.

#LI-LH1

kittl-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
A little about us

  • AI-native design: End-to-end workflows where a single prompt produces product shoots, social video, labels and full campaigns without switching tools

  • Millions of users: Built a large user base since 2022, with a clear product bet on where design is heading next

  • Diverse team: 120+ people from 30+ countries, building one product together

  • Product-led: Engineers, product managers, and designers shape what Kittl becomes

  • Strong backing: Over $45M raised from investors who've also backed Slack, Dropbox, and Figma

Learn more: www.kittl.com/career

Your role at Kittl

You will own design and product outcomes across one of Kittl's core surfaces, shaping the experiences that turn first-time consumer and prosumer users into repeat creators. Reporting to the Head of Product Design, you'll operate as a direct peer to PM and Engineering, bringing user evidence, strategic thinking, and a strong point of view to product decisions. You'll own the second half of product management: translating strategy into requirements, managing project timelines, coordinating with engineering, and driving features from concept to launch. Your work will directly influence activation, retention, and the quality of the AI-assisted creation experience millions of creators depend on.

What you'll do

  • Own product outcomes end-to-end: Take full ownership from problem framing and research through shipping, measurement, and iteration

  • Lead design of complex features: Design sophisticated product features with high visual craft and strategic product thinking

  • Raise the craft bar: Hold a high quality standard in visual and interaction design, elevating it through critique and pairing with peers

  • Manage the build: Coordinate with engineering, ensure quality throughout development, and own go-to-market readiness

  • Build reusable patterns: Contribute to Kittl's evolving design process, designing system and emerging AI patterns

What you'll need

  • Experience: Minimum 6 years designing digital products, with at least 2 years shipping consumer or prosumer products at scale

  • Portfolio: Strong portfolio showing end-to-end ownership including research, interaction design, visual craft, product thinking, and measurable impact of shipped work

  • Product ownership readiness: Demonstrated ability or clear readiness to step into product management responsibilities - managing timelines, coordinating stakeholders

  • AI design experience: Hands-on experience designing for AI-driven or generative product surfaces, with focus on embedding AI for genuine user value

  • Principled decision-making: Balances user needs, product constraints, and strategic direction to find the best feasible path forward through thoughtful compromise and clear decision-making

  • Bias for action: High quality bar combined with speed, comfort with ambiguity, and willingness to step beyond pure design into product ownership and execution

Interview process

  • Recruiter interview (30 min)

  • Hiring manager interview with Head of Product Design (60 min)

  • Take-home challenge

  • Challenge discussion interview with the team (60 min)

  • Bar raiser interview with CPO (45 min)


We are looking for someone

  • Exceptionally driven to drive impact and challenge the status quo

  • Who takes extreme ownership & gets things done

  • Who goes above and beyond in their role

  • Who is deeply passionate about what they do

Benefits

  • Maximise your impact: No matter if you're leading a team or you stand out by your domain expertise - all we care about is supporting you to maximise your own impact

  • Hackathons: Our hackathons provide an environment to experiment with new concepts, push boundaries, and potentially deliver the next big thing

  • Kittl Week: Each year, our global team gathers together for a whole week, to work, celebrate, get inspired, and have fun

  • Flexible working hours: Our core hours are 11am–5pm CET, leaving the rest of your schedule flexible to fit your style

  • Learning & development: Our L&D budget supports your professional growth

  • Vacation: Up to 30 vacation days per year

#li-remote

🌈 At Kittl, we embrace diversity and value every team member's unique background, identity, and experience. We're all about respect, honesty, and inclusivity. Together, we create a safe and supportive work environment where everyone thrives. Join us on this exciting journey of making our company and product even better!

krea-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Krea

At Krea, we are building next-generation AI creative tools.

We're dedicated to making AI intuitive and controllable for creatives - our mission is to build tools that empower human creativity, not replace it. We believe AI is a new medium that allows us to express ourselves through various formats - text, images, video, sound, and even 3D. We're building better, smarter, and more controllable tools to harness this medium. We recently took this a step forward with the launch of Krea 2, our first foundation model, built completely from scratch for aesthetic diversity and stylistic control.

We've raised over $83M and are backed by world-class investors such as a16z, Bain Capital, and Abstract. We work full-time and in-person at our waterfront office in San Francisco. We care about creativity: our team includes musicians, designers, visual artists, and engineers.

This role

Krea is building a creative platform for exceptional artists, designers, and studios to realize ambitious visions that were previously impossible or prohibitively time-intensive.

UI/UX design is essential to what we do: Artists can only get the results they desire if they can control our models in highly nuanced but intuitive ways, and this requires inventing brand new types of interfaces and UX patterns that make this powerful new technology approachable.

We're looking for a Product Designer to play a core role in all aspects of our UI/UX, ranging from refining our design system to conceiving of brand new experiences entirely.

What you'll do

  • Develop and extend Krea's design system: components, styles, tokens, documentation

  • Craft polished, production-ready UI specs for engineering

  • Work closely with product leadership and engineers to ship quickly and ensure quality

  • Design completely new types of creative interfaces to give artists unprecedented control over a wide library of different AI models

  • Make complex AI workflows feel simple

What we're looking for

  • 2–3+ years of UI design experience, ideally with startup exposure

  • Figma mastery—you should be a 10/10. Deep fluency in styles, variants, auto-layout, component architecture, and design system maintenance

  • Obsessive attention to detail. Meticulous, organized, craft-driven. We need someone who can work through all the edge cases

  • Solid grasp of user flows, interaction patterns, and UX fundamentals

  • Deep interest in and experience using AI creative tools. For example, you should know what LORAs are and have a good sense of how to prompt models well. We’re looking for someone who is passionate about this space and wants to play a role in shaping it

Your portfolio should show

  • Systematic thinking: component libraries, style guides, design systems you've built or maintained

  • Precision: clean, well-organized Figma files with clear specs

  • End-to-end UI work: flows, states, edge cases—not just hero screens

What we offer

  • Team: Work alongside a world-class team building the future of AI creative tooling

  • Impact: Significant scope and company-wide impact

  • Competitive compensation: generous salary & equity packages

  • Health & wellness: 100% health & 99% dental/vision insurance premiums covered for employees, health FSA accounts, & long-term disability coverage

  • Time off: Flexible PTO policy

  • Financial planning: 401k with a 4% company-sponsored match

  • Meals in the office: breakfast, lunch, dinner - you name it, we'll cover it

  • Transit: Ubers covered to & from the office

  • Sponsorship: We're open to sponsoring international visas where we can (e.g., STEM OPT, OPT, H-1B, O-1, E-3).

  • And more!

Please note the above benefits & perks are for full-time employees

leona-health-lead-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Leona is on a mission to empower everyone to take the best care of themselves, their patients, and their loved ones. We have an ambitious goal: to transform the way the world interacts with healthcare, because where you live shouldn't determine the quality of care you receive.

For patients, managing your health should feel empowering, not intimidating. For doctors, we want to eliminate the administrative noise so you can focus on what matters most: delivering exceptional care. We're reimagining what it looks like for doctors to care for patients in an AI-first world — starting with a platform that streamlines doctor-patient communication via WhatsApp, acting as an AI clinical assistant that automates non-urgent tasks, surfaces what's urgent, and gives patients the convenience of reaching their care team 24/7.

With bases in San Francisco and Mexico City, our team brings together years of experience scaling companies like Uber, Rappi, Modern Fertility, and Wonder across the US and Latin America. We're backed by a16z, General Catalyst, and Accel, and a remarkable group of angels including the founders of Nubank, Rappi, and Maven Clinic.

If you're hungry to build 0-to-1, and roll up your sleeves to make magic, thrive in ambiguity, and care deeply about building a better future, this role might be the perfect fit for you.

The Role

Location: San Francisco or Mexico City, but we can be flexible for the right candidate

We seek an experienced product designer to lead the design of a new tool aimed at giving doctors superpowers. If you’re driven by user experience, enjoy the challenge of solving complex design problems with easy-to-use solutions, and are looking to play a critical role in taking a product from 0 to 1, this role is for you.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design of high-end, impactful product experiences for Leona’s digital products

  • Spend time getting to know our target users and develop empathy for their unique needs

  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional stakeholders

  • Be a key decision-maker on a small but talented team

  • Help us make Leona a company that stands out for its design excellence

Requirements:

  • Has a proven track record of designing mobile-first digital products, with at least 7 years of relevant work experience

  • Spanish & English language fluency

  • Specific experience designing for native mobile apps (iOS or Android), with extensive knowledge of common design patterns + guidelines. Has experience designing user experiences for complex native mobile applications, and has extensive knowledge of common design patterns + guidelines

  • Mastery of the various tools needed for each step of the design process

  • Feels comfortable taking ideas from wireframes to pixel-perfect deliverables, and is excited about defining and owning this process

  • Experience working closely with engineers

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

  • A passion for building

What You Can Expect:

  • Autonomy & Responsibility: You will take ownership of your time and efforts, prioritizing the activities that have the largest impact for the company

  • Team Collaboration: We are very team oriented; you’ll have the opportunity to work with a small, nimble team of superstars, gaining insight into building a company from scratch. Everyone in the team is here to help each other - 24/7.

  • Mentorship: The team members are here to support your career growth goals within the company and afterwards

  • Ambiguity: There are a lot of unknowns given the early stage of the company, you will be responsible for navigating ambiguous environments and determining the best path forward

  • Dedication: If you prefer 9-5 environments, this role is not for you. While there is no strict ‘clocking in/clocking out’ schedule, the aggressive growth goals require the team to work more than 8 hours a day

  • Flexibility & Generous Benefits: Unlimited vacation policy, health insurance, wellness benefits, unique team offsites (past examples include hot air balloon rides, cooking classes, and padel tournaments).

lunon-founding-design-engineer.descriptionHtml:
Lunon is the world's first AI-native consulting firm. We run engagements for private equity firms and global enterprises across the full spectrum of consulting work. The work is institutional quality, delivered in a fraction of the time and cost.

We believe the traditional consulting model is fundamentally broken. Firms charge $500 an hour for analysts doing work that AI can do better, faster, and more rigorously. We are building the platform that proves it, and delivering the engagements that demonstrate it.

We have raised a $2M pre-seed round backed by General Catalyst, SV Angel, and top Silicon Valley names, with advisors across the world's leading PE firms and consulting practices.


What you'll own

As Lunon's Founding Design Engineer, your job is to make complex analytical work feel clear, fast, and inevitable. The platform you are building is where hundreds of millions of dollars in deals get analyzed and decided. Engagements are carried out end to end on it, from initial scoping through live AI-driven research and analysis, to polished reports and deliverables that clients access directly on the platform. The clients sitting on the other side expect something that matches the weight of that work, every pixel, every interaction, every data visualization has to be perfect.

You will own the intersection of design and engineering, turning high-stakes financial and strategic data into interfaces that PE partners and executives actually trust. You will build the design system and frontend standards that every future engineer inherits, making every incremental feature easier to ship and more refined to use.


How you'll work

  • Your workflow, your tools, your call. Paper, Framer, Figma, Claude Design, etc. straight into Claude Code or Cursor, whatever gets the best result fastest.

  • You ship it yourself. No handoffs, no waiting.

  • You stay on top of the best tools as they emerge and bring that to the team.

This is not a design role. This is not an engineering role. It's both, and the opportunity to define the visual and interaction language of a category that does not exist yet.


Must haves

You are a good fit for Lunon if you are a formidable design engineer. This means you stop at nothing to accomplish your goal. We don't care much about your current skills or even what you've done before; we care that you will be able to do anything you set your mind to.

You must be pragmatic. Lunon is a startup so something is always on fire. You need to know when to let little fires burn and when to break out the extinguisher.

You must have strong design taste and the engineering skills to bring your ideas to life. You should be equally comfortable prototyping as you are in code. You're obsessed with craft, the micro-interaction that feels off, the visualization that could tell a clearer story, the flow that adds one too many clicks.

You must be empathetic. We're building products for other people, so you need to understand how they think and why. You'll be the voice of the user in every product decision.

You must be an excellent communicator. You are building interfaces that put complex analytical work in front of some of the most demanding professionals in the world. Clarity has to come naturally.

Finally you must be gritty. You pick the hardest, highest-quality option regardless of the effort it takes and you push through it.


Why Lunon

  • Early equity in a category-defining company.

  • Young, hungry founding team. No bureaucracy, no politics, just building.

  • Small team, high trust, no one looking over your shoulder.

  • $2,400 yearly learning and tools stipend.

  • Early model access through an OpenAI partnership.

  • Remote

About the interview

  1. 30-minute intro call with founders

  2. Take-home design and build challenge

  3. 30-minute portfolio review and interview with Dhruv (CEO) and Connor (CTO)

  4. 3-5 day paid work trial

About the role

We have recently launched our direct-to-consumer platform that gives women access to GLP-1 care, hormone care, and 30+ healthcare specialties, connecting metabolic, hormonal, reproductive, mental, and physical health in one care experience. We are building for women who are tired of fragmented care, unclear pricing, limited follow-up, and healthcare experiences that treat each symptom or life stage in isolation.

What You'll Do:

  • We’re looking for a founding Product Design Lead to help build and scale Maven’s direct-to-consumer healthcare experiences.
  • This role sits at the intersection of consumer growth, healthcare access, product craft, AI-native ways of working, and trust-sensitive design.
  • It is a hands-on player-coach role with formal line management responsibility. You’ll lead a small team of senior Product Design/UXR practitioners while also owning high-priority product design work yourself.
  • You’ll report to the General Manager, Consumer and partner closely with Product, Engineering, Growth, Data, Clinical, Legal, Operations, and Support teams.
  • You will help Maven compete in a fast-moving and highly competitive consumer healthcare market while staying true to what makes Maven different: connected, clinically responsible, whole-person care for women.
  • You will be designing for users who are actively comparing options, making decisions quickly, weighing affordability, navigating uncertainty, and deciding whether they trust Maven enough to start and continue care.
  • The work will span both 0→1 product development and continuous optimization of live consumer journeys. You’ll help define new journeys, shape concepts, prototype, and bring new consumer healthcare offerings to market, while also improving existing funnels, onboarding, eligibility, pricing, payment, prescription, activation, retention, and cross-sell experiences through research, experimentation, data, and design craft.

What You'll Bring:

  • 7+ years of product design experience, including complex consumer product journeys and 0→1 product growth.
  • Experience formally managing or leading design teams.
  • Strong hands-on product design craft across UX, prototyping, visual design, mobile apps, and responsive web.
  • A portfolio showing D2C product design leadership, systems thinking, data-driven decision-making, high-quality execution, and measurable product impact.
  • Experience designing products where trust, comprehension, eligibility, pricing, access, personal data, or complex decision-making play a central role.
  • Experience with growth, onboarding, conversion, activation, retention, cross-sell, monetization, or lifecycle journeys, informed by research, data and experimentation.
  • A strong AI-native workflow and informed opinions on how AI can improve design quality, team capacity, and business value.

We’d especially love to see

  • Experience in healthcare, women’s health, telehealth, digital health, insurance, fintech, marketplaces, consumer subscriptions, or another regulated or trust-sensitive domain.
  • Experience designing products involving insurance, benefits, prescriptions, clinical eligibility, payments, care navigation, or personal health information.
  • Experience designing in a competitive direct-to-consumer category where acquisition, conversion, trust, differentiation, and retention all matter.

This is a remote role open to candidates based in the United States, with a strong preference for those based in San Francisco.

The base salary range for this role is $195,000-$230,000 per year. You will also be entitled to equity and benefits. Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, and skillset.

We are looking for a VP of Design to lead product design, brand design, and user research — and to help position Maven as a design leader in healthcare.

This is an AI-native role. We expect the person in this seat to use AI to move faster, think bigger, and raise the bar on what a small, high-performing team can produce. That means modernizing how the design org works — from research to production to cross-functional collaboration — and helping the rest of the company understand what's possible when design operates at its best.

We're looking for a leader who is close to the work, relentless about quality, and genuinely energized by the challenge of moving fast without losing craft.

  • Translate company goals into clear design priorities — and make sure the team is working on the things that move the needle
  • Drive conversion, member engagement, and clinical outcomes through design, not just aesthetics
  • Be a credible voice in executive forums: able to articulate why a design decision matters in terms of growth, retention, or clinical quality

  • Partner with go-to-market, clinical, and executive teams to maintain a brand that is distinctive, trustworthy, and mission-aligned
  • Oversee agency partnerships and brand production pipelines

  • Build an AI-native design practice: use AI tools to accelerate research synthesis, prototyping, production, and quality review — and establish workflows that become a model for the rest of the org
  • Create the conditions to ship faster without sacrificing craft: clear prioritization, strong feedback loops, shared standards, and a culture that celebrates both speed and quality
  • Embed user research as a core input to every decision, not a separate track that runs behind the work

  • Lead, grow, and retain a team of product designers and brand designers

  • Champion accessibility and equity in design practice

  • 10+ years of design experience, including 4+ years leading multidisciplinary design teams in a product-led company

  • Proven ability to connect design priorities to business goals — you think in outcomes, not outputs
  • AI-native working style: you use AI tools daily, you've built workflows around them, and you have strong opinions about how they change what a design team can do

About The Role:

It's about identifying the right problems, setting and fully owning the design vision for multiple complex areas, making strategic calls under ambiguity, and leading high-impact initiatives that raise the bar for the team around you.

  • Cross-functional leadership: You've driven complex projects across multiple teams and know how to create momentum without direct authority.
  • Mobile and web: Experience designing for mobile applications and responsive web.
  • Systems thinking: Ability to think beyond a flow and communicate a holistic system that can scale for any program
  • Appetite for complexity: Energized by ambiguity and solving complex problems, and comfortable making calls when the path isn't clear.
