middesk-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Middesk:

Middesk makes it easier for businesses to work together. Since 2018, we’ve been transforming business identity verification, replacing slow, manual processes with seamless access to complete, up-to-date data. Our platform helps companies across industries confidently verify business identities, onboard customers faster, and reduce risk at every stage of the customer lifecycle.

Middesk came out of Y Combinator, is backed by Sequoia Capital and Accel Partners, and was recently named to Forbes Fintech 50 List.

About The Role:

As a Product Designer at Middesk, you'll play a pivotal role in helping businesses uphold strong compliance standards and manage risk with confidence. You'll design intuitive experiences that empower customers to make informed compliance and risk decisions in highly regulated industries. Working closely with Product and Engineering partners, you'll own the end-to-end design process from discovery through delivery, bringing a balance of craft, systems thinking, and curiosity to every stage.

We follow a hybrid work model, and for this role, there is an expectation of 2 days per week in our SF office. Candidates should be based within a commutable distance, as we believe in the value of in-person collaboration and building strong team connections while also supporting flexibility where possible.

What You'll Do:

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to refine problems, explore solutions, and deliver designs that strike the right balance between customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints.

  • Own the end-to-end design process, from early discovery to launch, using design best practices to drive impact at every stage.

  • Turn dense or ambiguous data into experiences that build trust and clarity for our customers.

  • Use storytelling to bring clarity and meaning to complex business identity and risk concepts, helping others understand the "why" behind your work.

  • Shape and evolve Middesk's design system and visual language to ensure consistency, accessibility, and craft across all products.

What We're Looking For:

  • Over 8+ years of in house product design experience delivering impactful solutions for B2B products, with direct experience designing for platforms that work with business or consumer data.

  • A strong portfolio of work demonstrating the ability to turn complex or abstract customer challenges into simple, intuitive solutions.

  • Product-minded and can collaborate closely with PMs to help frame problems, scope work, and drive decisions rather than waiting for fully defined requirements.

  • Able to navigate and interpret complex data and reason about how best to surface it in the user experience. Sound judgment about how data is represented is core to the craft.

  • A systems thinker who bridges user experience and API-driven systems, with familiarity in developer tooling such as SDK configuration, setup flows, and technical onboarding.

  • Deeply familiar with LLM-powered development tooling (Claude Code, Codex, or similar) and able to use it to build end-to-end prototypes with little to no engineering support.

  • Strong communication skills, able to clearly articulate design decisions and advocate for customers' needs.

  • A proactive approach to advancing work, taking initiative to move projects forward and keep teams aligned through changing priorities.

  • Proficiency in design tools, including prototyping, collaborating in shared design files, and effectively leveraging and maintaining design system components.

Nice to Haves:

  • Working experience in product management, front-end development, or engineering.

midstream-health-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Midstream is an AI-native financial operating system for health systems, founded by experienced entrepreneurs and backed by top-tier investors. We give finance, supply chain, and managed care teams real-time visibility into where margin is at risk, with a precise action plan for capturing it before it's gone.

Purpose-built for healthcare's complexity, Midstream transforms structured, unstructured, and external data into instant, contract-aware insights that drive smarter decisions. Our AI agents unify spend and revenue operations across the full back-office, learning and adapting with every interaction and delivering always-on intelligence that no point solution or one-off engagement can match.

We're compressing months to minutes and turning post-period hindsight into in-the-moment foresight. The tempo of healthcare finance is changing, and Midstream is leading it.

Opportunity

Midstream is building the financial AI platform that helps health systems identify, validate, and realize millions of dollars in financial opportunities across supply chain, pharmacy, and managed care.

We're looking for a Product Designer who is excited to solve some of healthcare's most complex operational problems. You'll partner closely with Product, Engineering, Customer Success, and our health system partners to transform fragmented, manual workflows into intuitive, AI-powered experiences that help organizations make faster, better financial decisions.

This is a role for someone who loves owning product experiences from end to end. You'll help shape product strategy by understanding how customers work, uncovering opportunities through research, and translating complex enterprise workflows into intuitive, scalable experiences. You'll own the design process from discovery through launch and iteration, helping define how AI-native enterprise software should feel.

As our second designer, your primary focus will be building exceptional product experiences. At the same time, we're still an early-stage company where everyone contributes beyond the boundaries of their role when it creates the greatest impact. Whether supporting a product launch, improving customer-facing experiences, or helping communicate complex ideas more clearly, you'll bring a thoughtful design perspective wherever it helps move the company forward.

As one of the early designers at Midstream, you'll have the opportunity to shape not only the product, but how design contributes to the company as we scale.

What you'll be doing

Own end-to-end product design

Lead the complete design lifecycle—from customer research and problem definition to wireframes, prototypes, visual design, launch, and continuous iteration. Partner closely with Product and Engineering to deliver experiences that solve meaningful customer problems and create measurable business value.

Deeply understand our customers

Build a deep understanding of Midstream's business, our health system partners, and the operational challenges they face. Conduct user research, validate assumptions directly with customers, and continuously incorporate feedback into product decisions.

Design intuitive enterprise workflows

Transform complex data, financial processes, and AI-powered insights into elegant user experiences. Design workflows that serve a diverse set of enterprise users while balancing usability, flexibility, and scalability.

Shape our design system

Contribute to the strategy, architecture, and governance of Midstream's design system and component library. Create scalable patterns that enable consistency across products while supporting rapid product development as the company grows.

Design for AI-native products

Help define how AI integrates naturally into enterprise workflows. Design experiences that build user trust, communicate AI-generated insights effectively, and thoughtfully balance automation with human decision-making.

Contribute where design creates the greatest impact

As an early member of the design team, you'll occasionally apply your design expertise beyond the product when it helps the company move faster. Whether supporting a product launch, improving customer-facing experiences, or contributing to another high-impact initiative, you'll help ensure Midstream delivers thoughtful, cohesive experiences wherever customers interact with us.

Who you are

Data-driven

You use customer research, analytics, and measurable outcomes to guide design decisions. You know when to trust your instincts and when to validate assumptions through evidence.

Ownership mindset

You don't wait for someone else to answer the hard questions. You proactively engage with customers, collaborate deeply with Product and Engineering, challenge assumptions, and take responsibility for delivering meaningful outcomes.

Systems thinker

You naturally think beyond individual screens and consider how workflows, components, information architecture, and interactions come together into a cohesive product experience.

AI fluent

You understand the fundamentals of modern AI and machine learning well enough to design practical, trustworthy user experiences around them. You're excited by the opportunity to help define what great AI-native enterprise software looks like.

Bias to action

You thrive in fast-moving startup environments where learning, iteration, and shipping matter. You know when to sweat the details and when to move quickly, always balancing craftsmanship with progress.

Team-first

You care more about company impact than rigid job boundaries. While product design is your craft, you're motivated by solving the highest-impact problems alongside your teammates. You embrace the variety that comes with building an early-stage company and enjoy contributing wherever your design expertise can create the most value.

What we're looking for

  • 5–7 years of experience designing digital products, ideally within enterprise SaaS or workflow-intensive applications

  • Experience owning end-to-end product design, from user research through implementation and iteration

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating thoughtful UX, interaction design, and visual design across complex enterprise products

  • Experience simplifying data-rich workflows and designing for multiple user personas

  • Experience conducting customer research and translating insights into product decisions

  • Proficiency with Figma and modern design and prototyping tools

  • Experience collaborating closely with Product Managers and Engineers throughout the product development lifecycle

  • Strong communication skills with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale to technical and non-technical audiences

  • Curiosity about AI-powered products and enthusiasm for designing the next generation of enterprise software

  • Experience in high-growth startups or environments where adaptability and cross-functional collaboration are essential is a plus

Why this role matters

Healthcare organizations manage billions of dollars through complex operational workflows, yet many of the tools they rely on remain fragmented, manual, and difficult to use.

Every design decision at Midstream has the potential to help health systems uncover millions of dollars in financial opportunities, reduce administrative burden, and make better operational decisions.

As one of our first designers, you'll play a foundational role in defining how AI transforms enterprise healthcare operations while helping establish the design culture, product quality, and customer experience that will shape Midstream for years to come.

mural-lead-product-designer-growth-upper.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE TEAM

At Mural, we’re reimagining how teams think and create together. The Design and Research team brings clarity to complexity, shaping experiences that help people collaborate, ideate, and solve problems visually. We partner deeply with engineering, product, and research to invent the next generation of collaborative work combining craft, systems thinking, and bold exploration.

YOUR MISSION

As a Lead Product Designer focused on Growth, you’ll define how Mural earns user trust at the moments that matter most when someone first encounters the product's value, decides to go deeper, or chooses to stay.

This is end to end growth journey ownership. It's about designing the logic of how Mural grows: the moments where clarity converts, where friction is a design failure, and where the line between growth and product quality either holds or breaks. You'll work across discovery, activation, and pricing surfaces, onboarding paths, upgrade flows, lifecycle touchpoints, and in-product nudges. Most importantly, you'll orchestrate how those surfaces work together and set the standard for how growth design is practiced at Mural.

You'll succeed if you can bring full journey thinking, rigor and craft to a domain that often defaults to shortcuts and if you can help a cross-functional team understand what good growth design actually looks like.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

Player Responsibilities (Individual Contributor Work):

  • Define high-quality, user-centered discovery, activation, and monetization experiences across problem to success flows, upgrade flows, pricing surfaces, and lifecycle touchpoints — setting patterns that scale across the platform.

  • Work from concept to production, delivering thoughtful UX, polished visual design, and vibe coded prototypes that help the organization understand direction, risk, and value.

  • Use behavioral data as a primary design input: interpret funnel metrics, experiment results, and user signals to inform design decisions, not just validate them.

  • Design and lead experiments across acquisition, activation, and expansion funnels — from hypothesis formation through read-out, in close partnership with product and data science.

  • Establish reusable growth patterns in Mural's design system that balance clarity, persuasion, and long-term user trust.

  • Partner with engineers to ensure accurate, high-quality implementation of flows and components.

Coaching Responsibilities (Practice Leadership):

  • Model how to hold craft and commercial intent simultaneously — showing peers what it looks like to design for conversion without compromising user trust.

  • Mentor designers working on growth-adjacent surfaces, developing their instincts around hierarchy, motivation, friction, and funnel thinking.

  • Contribute to how the team understands growth design as a discipline: a principled approach to earning user commitment.

  • Champion the relationship between growth quality and product quality, helping leadership understand when they align and when they're in tension.

  • Partner with research, data science, and product to elevate experimentation quality across the organization.

Hybrid Responsibilities (Both Player & Coach):

  • Reframe problems at the funnel level helping teams understand where value is earned or lost and why.

  • Lead workshops or working sessions that bring clarity to pricing, packaging, onboarding, and upgrade moment opportunities.

  • Collaborate with product, research, and data science to define success metrics, shape experiment hypotheses, and interpret outcomes.

  • Advocate for user trust as a growth asset, not an obstacle to conversion — and model how design holds that line.

Design & Research Team Contribution:

  • Share growth approaches for designing discovery, onboarding, and identity flows with peers through critique and collaboration.

  • Partner with research, data, and product teams to elevate experimentation quality and improve how Mural understands user value signals.

  • Contribute to a culture of design excellence, especially in areas where growth and monetization intersect with core product experiences.WHAT YOU'LL BRING

  • 5+ years of product design experience working on complex applications, ideally in PLG, SaaS, or self-serve products.

  • Comfort working in fast-moving, experiment-driven environments with frequent iteration and learning.

  • Experience designing in-product discovery, onboarding, sign-up, or activation flows.

  • Exceptional craft: visual clarity, spacing, motion, and interaction polish are second nature.

  • Strong interaction design skills and a careful approach to visual polish, hierarchy, motion, and clarity.

  • Ability to design within systems, understanding how decisions cascade across surfaces and journeys.

  • Experience partnering with product and data teams to interpret behavioral insights, experiment results, or funnel metrics.

  • Curiosity and proactive problem solving: you explore edge cases, anticipate constraints, and think beyond the immediate brief.

  • Empathy for first-time users and sensitivity to trust, motivation, and cognitive load.

  • Strong communication skills that help cross-functional partners make smart, user-centered decisions.

What you’ll bring

  • 8+ years of product design experience, ideally in SaaS, productivity tools, collaboration software, or product-led growth environments.

  • A track record of leading growth, monetization, or conversion-focused design work — not just contributing to it.

  • Deep fluency in funnel thinking: you understand acquisition, activation, retention, and expansion as a connected system, not isolated moments.

  • Strong data instincts: you can read behavioral data, interpret experiment results, and use both to sharpen design decisions.

  • Exceptional craft: visual clarity, spacing, motion, and interaction polish are second nature.

  • Systems thinking: you understand how decisions cascade across surfaces, journeys, and user relationships over time.

  • Experience mentoring or leading other designers, even informally — you know how to raise the quality of work around you.

  • Strong communication skills that help cross-functional partners make smart, user-centered decisions.

  • Comfort operating in spaces where patterns don’t yet exist and playbooks need to be written.


Also great if you bring

  • Experience with pricing architecture, packaging strategy, or monetization model design.

  • Deep experience mapping and designing activation journeys — the full arc from first action to genuine value realization.

  • Hands-on experience using AI-assisted tools and vibe coding to prototype growth flows, simulate behavioral nudges, and stress-test funnel logic in motion — treating code as a design material for rapid exploration.

  • Background in organic acquisition or activation funnels at scale.

  • Familiarity with AI-assisted experiences or contextual intelligence in growth flows.

  • Experience working with data science teams on experimentation frameworks or causal inference.

  • History of shaping 0→1 growth systems or redesigning broken acquisition or retention loops.

Why you’ll love Mural

You’ll help shape how millions of people discover value in Mural, understand what the product can do for them, and make confident choices about their journey. You’ll design experiences that balance business goals with user trust, clarity, and delight. You’ll collaborate with thoughtful partners who care about evidence, craft, and outcomes.

At Mural, we “drink our own champagne” and use our product daily to collaborate, ideate, and prototype together. This role is Canada Remote. Your design work will shape how millions of people around the world collaborate.

Compensation offered will be determined by factors such as location, level, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Equal Opportunity

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

n8n-senior-staff-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

We’re looking for a seasoned Product Designer who thrives in ambiguity and challenging problem spaces.

n8n is a powerful, flexible technical tool, which means the problems you tackle as a designer are complex. Your design decisions must account for diverse user workflows, technical constraints, and how changes impact the entire platform. To thrive here, you will need to love talking to users, understanding technology, and reducing complexity and scope.


We’re currently hiring for different teams with specific focus on:

  • Enterprise: You’ve worked on technical B2B platforms where workflows are the product. You’ve designed for scale, governance and collaboration across teams including permissions, environments, observability and failure modes included and you’re comfortable making deeply complex systems feel coherent and simple.

  • AI: This team is perfect for designers who've worked on AI tools, agents, or builders and want to push the boundaries of AI-powered automation. You'll define the future of AI-powered workflows.

  • Growth: We're seeking a designer who thrives on rapid iteration and experimentation. You have experience optimizing onboarding and activation flows, you're motivated by moving metrics, and you excel at testing, learning, and iterating quickly.

  • Marketplace: This role is ideal for designers experienced with multi-sided platforms (like e-commerce or talent marketplaces) where you balance distinct needs of the supply and demand sides. You'll build something new from the ground up in a brand new team.

Our team structure evolves quickly and these team assignments may shift in the coming weeks.


🎯 Regardless of the team your main goal will be to lead end-to-end product design on complex workflows that elevate n8n’s user experience, ship measurable outcomes, and raise the quality bar across our platform. To do so, here are your responsibilities:

End-to-end product design

  • Lead the full design process for your team, from discovery to polished delivery, collaborating closely with PMs and engineers.

  • Consistently ship high-quality, visually cohesive designs that improve the overall UX at every release.

  • Work effectively on complex features with a strong engineering mindset and understanding of the underlying technology.

  • Take ownership of complex, multi-faceted problems and drive them to completion with initiative and autonomy.

Research, feedback, and UX quality

  • Champion the user by running interviews, usability tests, and research to inform critical product and business decisions.

  • Master the feedback loop by gathering, synthesizing, and acting on input while giving actionable critique to elevate teammates’ work.

  • Balance speed and quality in an MVP-driven environment, navigating ambiguity while maintaining a high bar.

Systems thinking and platform coherence

  • Design in systems, integrating solutions into the broader n8n platform and safeguarding the product’s big picture.

  • Account for edge cases, constraints, and interaction details so users never end up in impossible states.

  • Collaborate across teams and designers to ensure consistency and quality across shared patterns and components.

Strategy, impact, and innovation

  • Shape team strategy by influencing planning, prioritization, and scope with a strong design perspective tied to KPIs.

  • Explore and adopt AI and automation tools to push the boundaries of design practice and AI-powered workflows.

REQUIREMENTS

Must-haves

  • 🎨 Product design excellence: You’re proficient across product design, UX, UI, and qualitative research, delivering polished, detail-oriented work.

  • 🧠 Technical mindset: You collaborate effectively with engineers and understand how software is built, including common web technologies.

  • 🧭 Ownership & delivery: You’ve shipped end-to-end features in smaller teams or startups and can drive complex problems to measurable outcomes.

  • ⚡ Fast, focused execution: You operate at high speed in an MVP-driven environment, balancing quality and velocity amid ambiguity.

  • 📈 Outcome orientation: You use research and metrics to inform decisions and consistently deliver solutions that enable team KPIs.

  • 🤝 Feedback & collaboration: You’re open and non-defensive in critique and provide actionable feedback that raises the team’s bar.

  • 🧪 Curiosity for AI: You’re enthusiastic about AI and innovation, actively exploring new tools and approaches to advance the craft.

  • 📅 Experience level: You have 5+ years in product design with demonstrable impact on shipped products.

Nice-to-haves

  • 💻 Front-end fluency: You can prototype or collaborate using HTML/CSS/JavaScript frameworks.

  • 🧩 AI & automation domain: You’ve designed AI or automation products; familiarity with n8n is a plus.

  • 🔁 Process improvement: You proactively refine team rituals and workflows to increase effectiveness.

  • 📚 Continuous growth: You invest in your craft and are motivated by creating tangible product and company impact.

  • 🔎 Discovery frameworks: You know methodologies like Continuous Discovery or Shape Up.

  • 📊 Data-informed design: You’re comfortable with metrics, A/B testing, or SQL to guide decisions.

  • 🚀 Entrepreneurial drive: You’ve built startups or side projects that show initiative and creative problem-solving.

Why join us?

At n8n, your work won’t disappear into a slide deck. You’ll lead high-impact design across core product surfaces—shaping AI-powered workflows, enterprise features, growth journeys, or a new marketplace—from discovery to delivery. You’ll join a fast-growing, remote-first company where autonomy, experimentation, and craft matter, partnering closely with PMs and engineers to ship real outcomes to a passionate global community.

Sound like a challenge you’re excited to take on?

Apply now — and help us build the future of automation.

n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work.

Our company language is English.

You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n (https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35).

Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future.

Benefits

  • Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay.

  • Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity.

  • Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge:

    • Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are.

    • US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are.

  • Health & wellness 🩺 –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage.

  • Future planning 💰 –

    • Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.*

    • US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match.

  • Financial security 🛡️ –

    • Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.*

    • US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones.

  • Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills.

  • A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it!

  • Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description.

  • Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about.

  • AI enablement 🤖 – We believe in working smarter—everyone gets an unlimited AI budget to explore and use the best tools to boost productivity and creativity.

  • Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang.

* Country-specific details are provided in your contract.

nex-product-designer-contract.descriptionHtml:
Nex is on a mission to help families rediscover the joy of movement. Created by parents for parents, Nex combines technology and play to deliver fun, social, and interactive experiences powered by natural body motion, encouraging kids and adults to move more, play more, and have fun together. Nex Playground, the company’s award-winning active play system, is purpose-built to get families moving year-round, with safety and privacy as core considerations in its intentional design. It is certified kidSAFE+ COPPA compliant and built to support healthy, active play for all ages and abilities.

Nex Playground features a growing library of 50+ experiences, including motion and dance games, fitness and educational experiences, and Nex Originals. Content includes collaborations with partners like Hasbro, Sesame Workshop, and NBCUniversal. Nex has been recognized by Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies, TIME’s Best Inventions, and Parents’ Best Entertainment System for Families, and has earned Red Dot, IDEA, and Core77 international design awards. We encourage you to explore Have Fun and Is Motion Gaming Back?, as they offer a deeper look into our culture, values, and explain how our approach to motion gaming differs from previous generations.

To protect yourself from recruitment scams, please note that Nex communicates through official company emails ending in @nex.inc. If you receive a suspicious email or message, please do not respond and report it immediately to us.

Location: Remote (US) or San Jose, CA
Annual Salary: USD 125,000 - USD 175,000
Type: 3 month contract with potential for FTE conversion
Reports to: Director of Product Design

The Role

We are looking for a talented and motivated Product Designer to own the design and user experience (UX) of Playground. This role will be critical in creating an engaging, family-friendly interface that enhances how users interact with Playground. You will collaborate closely with our product and engineering teams to design and iterate on experiences that support our mission to connect families through fun and physical activity. Using first principles thinking, you’ll be tirelessly seeking opportunities to improve the first-time user experience, the core browsing experience, and other features intended to engage and retain users.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design process for the OS, focusing on user needs, usability, and delightful interactions for both kids and adults.
  • Design and prototype the UI/UX for our custom Android-based operating system, including navigation, settings, and play modes.
  • Design user-friendly web-based features that allow users to manage their Playground account off-device
  • Work closely with product leaders, engineers, and marketers to understand requirements, align on objectives, and deliver innovative design solutions.
  • Create wireframes, prototypes, and high-fidelity designs for new features. Collaborate with engineering to refine designs based on feedback and testing.
  • Work to build more consistent practice around team-wide customer empathy by participating in and leading research and testing
  • Conduct user research and usability testing to validate design decisions, identify pain points, and iterate on solutions.
  • Help build and maintain a consistent design language and design system for both the OS and web platforms.
  • Conduct regular audits and usability testing to ensure the design system meets user needs and maintains a high level of quality.
  • Advocate for the value and importance of a design system to stakeholders across the company.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Design, Human-Computer Interaction, or a related field.
  • 8+ years of experience in product design, UI/UX design, or a similar role.
  • Experience with software development and the processes and practices associated with it.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating experience in interaction design, visual design, and user experience, with a focus on consumer-facing digital products.
  • An eye for high-quality, well-crafted visual and interaction design.
  • Proficiency with design and prototyping tools such as Figma, Sketch or similar.
  • Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions and advocate for user-centered design.
  • Ability to balance multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
  • A knack for figuring out ambiguous problems and shaping them into clear goals.
  • Passion for creating engaging experiences for families, children, and friends.

Nice To Have

  • Experience designing operating systems, or 10-foot UI experiences.
  • Experience conducting user research and usability testing.
  • Familiarity with designing for entertainment experiences with a library of content that is curated and editorialized.
  • Knowledge of design systems and creating reusable design components.

#LI-Remote

We Offer

  • Competitive compensation package.
  • Flexible working hours and vacation policy.
  • Product-driven culture that treasures talents and individual growth.
  • Front-row seat and hands-on experience with cutting edge technologies in the evolving gaming field

Nex is located in San Jose, California, USA and Hong Kong. Learn more about us at nex.inc/who-we-are.

We encourage applications even if you don’t meet more than 50% of the requirements — we believe that experience comes in many forms!

Nex is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, gender identity, and sexual orientation), national origin, ancestry, age, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. This policy applies to all individuals at every stage of the employment relationship, including all current and prospective employees, and covers all employment decisions including recruitment, hiring, job assignment, promotion, compensation, benefits, training, discipline and termination.

We are committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment and to fostering an inclusive environment for all employees.

notion-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About The Role

Imagine yourself in the 1970s or 80s thinking through how computing should look and feel for people who had never seen one before. That's what we're trying to do at Notion — make software that feels timeless, with the craftsmanship of German cameras, playfulness of Japanese toys, and mass appeal of Coca-Cola. We have no end of fascinating challenges that can only be solved by someone with innate product & UX sense, technical aptitude, great taste, and impeccable craft.

This role can be based in either San Francisco or New York City. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Design product concepts that balance vision, craft, speed, and business potential.

  • Craft every detail of new product features, from idea to UX to pixel-perfect execution.

  • Run projects end to end with engineers to drive your vision to the ship line.

  • Partner closely with our Customer Experience, Sales, and Customer Success teams to understand what each of our diverse user segments need, want, and love about Notion. Use this data and acquired intuition to prioritize, plan, and scope our product roadmap.

  • Work with Marketing to devise new ways to tell great stories throughout the user lifecycle, and across our site, product, help guides and other channels.

  • Create new patterns that are intuitive, practical, and convergent. Evolve our design system intentionally as we scale.

Skills You'll Need to Bring:

  • You have well-rounded skills and experience to run projects independently end to end. 5+ years of working experience.

  • You seek to understand the needs of customers then explore and advocate for the strongest user experiences to solve their problems

  • You enjoy untangling vague conceptual problems and have a sharp intuition for the most accessible mental models and flows, so users can immediately start gaining value out of the product.

  • You create clear, intuitive, and visually appealing human interfaces.

  • You care about business needs, implications, and practicality of your designs. You don't get stuck on pretty UI or deep abstractions and can balance between craft, speed, and the bottom line.

  • You have strong beliefs, loosely held. You're a good listener who collaborates well with different stakeholders. You observe and internalize all inputs and feedback to help you reach an optimal decision.

  • You understand how to tell stories using both words and visuals, and strategize the best ways to drive alignment.

  • You value working cross-functionally with project management, engineering, research and data — as well as design peers.

Nice to Haves:

  • You've designed and built great tools with small teams in the past.

  • You bring unique strengths and perspectives to the team. We're looking to build a diverse team where our skills and experience can complement each other.

  • You've experienced the pain of fragmented tools and information silos created by them, and have a strong urge to fix it.

  • You're familiar with the work of computing heroes like Douglas Engelbart, Alan Kay, Bret Victor, etc. — and understand why we're big fans.

  • You are a designer who can code!

Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $285,000 - $330,000 per year.

By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy and NYLL 144.

#LI-Onsite

A Note on AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.

Equal Opportunity & Accommodations

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.

Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

nourish-staff-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Health is the most important thing in life, and the American healthcare system is completely broken - poor outcomes, high cost, bad patient experience. We're building a new system from the ground up.

Our mission is to improve people’s health by making it easy to live a healthy lifestyle.

Nourish is the country's largest dietitian-led metabolic health clinic. We’re an AI-native digital health system matching patients with 10,000+ Registered Dietitians, physicians, medications, lab testing, and AI agents to deliver insurance-covered care across all 50 states. Founded four years ago, we've completed millions of appointments, tripled year-over-year, and partnered with health plans covering 200M+ Americans across 250+ health systems.

In 2026 we raised a $100M Series C, bringing total funding to $215M. The round was led by Menlo Ventures, with participation from Thrive Capital, Index Ventures, J.P. Morgan Growth Equity Partners, Maverick Ventures, Y Combinator, BoxGroup, Atomico, Daybreak, and Operator Partners.

Learn more about our Series C here: Nourish Blog, Bloomberg, Fierce Healthcare, Digital Native, The Pulse Podcast.

This is not a job for everyone. We hold an extremely high bar because we believe talent density is our biggest competitive advantage. We're looking for people who actively choose hard, ambiguous problems, who run toward unglamorous work, give and receive candid feedback, and bring relentless resilience without the ego. Our work is important, but we are not self-important. We do this because we’re solving one of the hardest problems in the world, and the problem matters. If that's you, we disproportionately reward it.

About the Role:

At Nourish, we believe the quality of a product is a massive differentiator that separates great products and services from average ones. As the company scales rapidly and builds new products, we are looking for a Staff Product Designer who can raise the bar and help integrate our new offerings in a seamless way.

In this role, you’ll own projects that will set the strategic foundation for how Nourish’s product offerings expand and see the projects through from conception to execution and implementation. You’ll use your expertise in design, user psychology, and data-driven decision-making to create intuitive experiences and raise the bar for craft.

This person will join our small design team and report directly to our Head of Design. We are a team that cares about our work, but we try not to take ourselves too seriously. We believe deeply that empathy, trust, and collaboration are what drive the best outcomes and that work can feel like play!

This role is full-time and can be based in either NYC (hybrid, in-office 3-4 days per week) or SF (remote until we open our SF office).

Check out EPD at Nourish and Design Values to learn more about our team!

Key Responsibilities:

  • Establish best practices for information architecture. As Nourish has expanded our product offerings, ensuring that the user experience stays consistent has become more challenging. You will be driving forward the execution and vision of what it looks like to build an integrated preventative health product offering.
  • Design best-in-class experiences for all our users. Your work will not be limited to one area of our platform but instead will span our patient, provider, and growth products. You will iterate on existing features, create net new features, and continue to test both.
  • Help drive qualitative user research. You’ll build prototypes, conduct interviews, and create surveys to test hypotheses about designs and products.
  • Grow and maintain our design system. You’ll help the team operate efficiently and keep our quality consistent by helping manage our component library.
  • Help build a design culture at Nourish. We want to be a company that is known for quality and craft, and is willing to go the extra mile to make our patient and provider experiences excellent. No detail is too small, and no journey is under-considered.

We’d love to hear from you if:

  • You have 10+ years experience designing compelling digital products.
  • You are deeply customer- and craft-oriented. You care about understanding real user needs and translating them into clear, thoughtful product experiences. You have strong design fundamentals and know how to apply them in messy, real-world product environments.
  • You are a builder. You like taking ideas from 0 to 1 and then improving them relentlessly. Shipping matters to you. You’re comfortable iterating quickly and learning as you go.
  • You take ownership and push work forward. This is not an environment where designers wait for perfect briefs or fully defined problems. You’re comfortable working through ambiguity, forming strong opinions, and helping drive product decisions alongside product and engineering.
  • You communicate with a high signal‑to‑noise ratio. We value clear thinking and efficient communication. Whether written or verbal, you can explain ideas quickly and directly. You don’t rely on long explanations or filler to make a point.
  • You do your own stunts. No task is beneath you if it helps move the product forward. You might run user interviews, refine product copy, improve a flow, help prepare a deck, or jump into a messy problem that doesn’t have an obvious owner.
  • You’re comfortable in a demanding environment. We move quickly and hold a high bar for quality and accountability. There is little room to coast here. People who thrive on this team tend to have grit, curiosity, and a pragmatic, roll‑up‑your‑sleeves attitude.
  • You understand that meaningful work sometimes requires extra effort. Startups have moments where the work extends beyond a tidy 9–5 schedule. If you’re the kind of person who cares deeply about the outcome and is willing to lean in when the work demands it, you’ll likely feel at home here.
  • You’re motivated by impact. The problems we’re working on—nutrition, chronic disease, and preventative healthcare—are meaningful and complex. The right person for this role is energized by the opportunity to help build something that materially improves people’s lives.

npr-staff-product-designer-mobile.descriptionHtml:
OVERVIEW

A thriving, mission-driven multimedia organization, NPR produces award-winning news, information, and music programming in partnership with hundreds of independent public radio stations across the nation. The NPR audience values information, creativity, curiosity, and social responsibility – and our employees do too. We are innovators and leaders in diverse fields, from journalism and digital media to IT and development. Every day, our employees and member stations touch the lives of millions worldwide.

Across our organization, we’re building a workplace where collaboration is essential, diverse voices are heard, and inclusion is the key to our success. We are committed to doing the right thing in our journalism and in every role at NPR. This means that integrity, adherence to our ethical standards, and compliance with legal obligations are fundamental responsibilities for every employee at NPR.

Application Instructions or Deadline: Cover letter is not required but encouraged. Portfolio of work is required with a link and any password needed.

Intro to Position

As a Staff Product Designer, you are a key leader in the product design process, from strategic concept development to inspecting pixels prior to launch. You will lead cross-functional design initiatives, drawing on a full spectrum of expertise spanning interaction design, product strategy, design systems, and prototyping.

This role champions design excellence across multidisciplinary project teams, partnering closely with researchers, product managers, and software engineers, while elevating the broader practice of design across the organization. Your mission is to shape accessible, elegant, and highly engaging digital experiences for millions of public media listeners and internal colleagues alike.

This is a union-represented role covered under the terms of a collective bargaining agreement with NABET-CWA DMU.

Responsibilities

  • Design Strategy & Mission Alignment: Drive cross-organizational design strategy and product vision by translating audience insights into scalable digital experiences that align with NPR's public service mission and strengthen long-term audience relationships.
  • End-to-End Mobile Product Discovery: Lead end-to-end product discovery and experience design for NPR’s next-generation mobile platform, guiding projects from opportunity framing and audience research through prototyping, validation, systems design, and launch.
  • Personalization & Audience Engagement: Direct the user-experience strategy for NPR’s personalization engine overhaul, crafting adaptive, habit-forming digital experiences that increase audience engagement, retention, and trust while honoring public media values.
  • Evidence-Driven Design Culture: Champion an evidence-driven design culture across product teams, using rapid experimentation, audience feedback, and measurable outcomes to validate ideas early and ground product decisions in actual audience behavior.
  • Cross-Functional & External Collaboration: Partner closely with Product, Software Engineering, Research, Data, Newsroom/Editorial teams, and external UX consultants to align strategy, refine implementations, and define the future of NPR's digital portfolio.
  • Design Systems & Scalability: Build, scale, and maintain robust, accessible design systems that harmonize and elevate the user experience across web, native mobile, and connected audio surfaces.
  • Inclusive Design & Accessibility: Champion inclusive design principles and accessibility standards (WCAG) across all digital products to ensure NPR's platforms are universally accessible to diverse national audiences.
  • Design Mentorship & Craft Excellence: Partner with mid-level and senior designers to provide constructive design critiques, foster professional growth, and uphold high visual and functional standards across initiatives.
  • Workshop Facilitation & Co-Creation: Facilitate design thinking workshops, discovery sprints, and co-creation sessions with product, editorial, and technical stakeholders to drive collaborative problem-solving.
  • Design Advocacy & Network Engagement: Present design strategies, product vision, and user-centered rationale clearly and persuasively to cross-functional teams, member station partners, and executive leadership.

The above duties and responsibilities are not an exhaustive list of required responsibilities, duties and skills. Other duties may be assigned, and this job description can be modified at any time.

Minimum Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience leading product design strategies and shipping scalable digital products across web and mobile ecosystems.
  • 2+ years as a Staff, Principal, or equivalent senior individual contributor.
  • Native mobile design expertise (iOS & Android) with a proven focus on adaptive experiences, responsive layouts, and comprehensive mobile design systems.
  • Exceptional product judgment and systems thinking.
  • Proven ability to design inclusive interfaces that comply with WCAG and web accessibility standards.
  • Strong proficiency in design thinking frameworks and agile methodologies, integrating user-centered practices seamlessly into delivery cycles.
  • Versatility across low- to high-fidelity prototyping techniques to rapidly validate ideas and align product teams.
  • Strong track record of designing across complex contexts, including both consumer-facing platforms and internal enterprise tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Demonstrated experience utilizing product analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Amplitude) to evaluate user behavior, measure performance, and guide iterative design decisions.
  • Experience scoping, estimating, and structuring design work streams for multi-designer projects.

Required Skills/Competencies

  • Design Communication: Exceptional ability to articulate complex design decisions clearly and solicit constructive, actionable feedback from cross-functional partners.
  • Visual & Interaction Mastery: Mastery of visual design principles, information architecture, interaction patterns, and modern design tools (e.g., Figma).
  • Pragmatic Scope Management: Strong ability to balance innovative design solutions with technical constraints and project timelines, accurately scoping project workload.
  • Technical Framework Literacy: Solid understanding of modern technology frameworks that power digital platforms (e.g., APIs, content management systems, mobile SDKs).
  • Facilitation & Influence: Demonstrated ability to lead co-creation sessions and influence product strategy without direct managerial authority.
  • Curiously & Humility: Bringing a builder’s mindset to complex product challenges.

Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Human-Computer Interaction (HCI), Interaction Design, Digital Media, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Work Location & Requirements

  • NPR Remote-Permitted: This is a remote-permitted role. This role is based out of our Washington, D.C. office, but the employee may choose to work on a remote basis from a location that NPR approves. You will have the option of working (a) remotely from a location of your choosing within the United States that is supported by NPR; (b) on-site at an NPR facility, based on the availability of desks and approval from NPR; or (c) a combination of both. Regardless of where you choose to work from, you may be expected to travel to other locations from time to time to perform the duties of your position.

Job Type

  • This is a full-time, exempt position.

Compensation

Salary Range: The U.S.-based anticipated salary range for this opportunity is $149,894.06 - $‎154,390.88 plus benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum salaries NPR expects to provide for new hires for the position across all US locations.

NPR Benefits: NPR provides comprehensive benefits for employees and dependents. Regular, full-time employees scheduled to work 30 hours or more per week are eligible to enroll in NPR’s benefits options. Benefits include access to health and wellness, paid time off, and financial well-being. Plan options include medical, dental, vision, life/ accidental death and dismemberment, long-term disability, short-term disability, and voluntary retirement savings to all eligible NPR employees.

nyc-oti-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
The Office of Technology and Innovation (OTI) leverages technology to drive opportunity, improve public safety, and help government run better across New York City. From delivering affordable broadband to protecting against cybersecurity threats and building digital government services, OTI is at the forefront of how the city delivers for New Yorkers in the 21st century. Follow us on social media @NYCOfficeofTech, and visit www.nyc.gov/oti to learn more.

At OTI, we offer great benefits, and the chance to work on projects that have a meaningful impact on millions of people. You'll have the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technology and collaborate with other passionate professionals who share your drive and commitment to making a difference through technology.

OUR WORK
The Public Interest Technology (PIT) Crew, at the NYC Office of Technology and Innovation, is a new team that builds the technology, products, and services needed to deliver a more affordable New York City. We design, build, and launch exceptional public-facing products for New Yorkers. Learn more at nyc.gov/pitcrew.

Job Description
We are hiring Senior Product Designers to design and ship resident-facing products end-to-end. This is a hands-on role spanning user research, interaction design, visual design, and content design. You will pair closely with product managers, engineers, other designers, policy teams, and other city employees to move from problem statements to working products and services for New Yorkers. You will lead design across the full process: framing the problem, conducting user research, building prototypes, designing interfaces, and partnering with product managers and engineers through build and launch. You will also lead modern design practices for the team: how we conduct research, how we use shared design systems, and how we produce quality products and services at pace and scale.

Responsibilities will include, but not limited to:
- Lead end-to-end design on resident-facing products, from concept to launch, owning user research, interaction design, content design, and visual design.
- Move quickly through rapid prototyping, usability testing, MVP iteration, pilot, and public launch, making pragmatic tradeoffs between scope, quality, and timing.
- Plan and conduct user research with New Yorkers, including interviews, usability sessions, and field visits, and synthesize findings into actionable choices for the team.
- Design clear user flows, information architecture, wireframes, and high-fidelity interfaces, and help build prototypes to test interactions.
- Practice plain-language content design, turning complex eligibility rules, legal language, and agency processes into product copy that is clear, accurate, and easy to act on.
- Partner with product managers, engineers, user researchers, and other OTI employees on day-to-day product decisions, and contribute to scoping and prioritization.
- Work directly with agency staff, policy advisors, and legal counsel to translate complex rules and regulations into experiences that are easy to use.
- Build accessibility into the design process from the start and partner with engineers to ship products that meet the city's quality and accessibility standards.
- Contribute to a shared design system and reusable patterns that make the next product faster to design than the last one.
- Shape the design culture of a small, mission-driven team, including mentorship, and onboarding for future hires.
- Perform special projects and initiatives as assigned.

HOURS/SHIFT
Day - Due to the necessary technical duties of this position in a 24/7 operation, candidate may be required to work various shifts such as weekends and/or nights/evenings.

WORK LOCATION
Brooklyn, NY

TO APPLY
Please go to www.cityjobs/jobs/search and search for Job ID #782373

* Interested applicants with other civil service titles who meet the preferred requirements should also submit a resume for consideration

SUBMISSION OF A RESUME IS NOT A GUARANTEE THAT YOU WILL RECEIVE AN INTERVIEW
APPOINTMENTS ARE SUBJECT TO OVERSIGHT APPROVAL

OTI participates in E-Verify

IT PROJECT SPECIALIST - 95710


Minimum Qualifications


1. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college in computer science, engineering, human computer interaction, interactive media, digital and graphics design, data visualization, communication or a related field, and four years of satisfactory full-time experience related to the area(s) required by the particular position and a specialization in a relevant technology, process, methodology and/or domain; or

2. An associate degree from an accredited college in computer science, engineering, human computer interaction, interactive media, digital and graphics design, data visualization, communication or a related field, and six years of satisfactory full-time experience related to the area(s) required by the particular position and a specialization in a relevant technology, process, methodology and/or domain; or

3. A baccalaureate degree from an accredited college, and eight years of satisfactory full-time experience related to the area(s) required by the particular position and a specialization in a relevant technology, process, methodology and/or domain; or

4. Education and/or experience which is equivalent to "1", "2", or "3" above.


Preferred Skills


The successful candidate should possess the following skills and experience: - 5+ years of professional product design experience, with a portfolio showing user-facing digital products you have shipped. - End-to-end design experience comfortable owning research, interaction design, content design, and visual design, even if you have a stronger affinity for some of them. - Direct, hands-on experience taking a product from concept through launch, not only iterating on existing flows. - Experience working on small, cross-functional product teams alongside product managers, engineers, and researchers. - Working fluency with modern design tools (Figma) and practices, including prototyping, design systems, version control for design files, and design handoff to engineering. - Strong written and verbal communication Ability to explain design decisions to non-designers, write clear documentation, and represent the team in conversations with agency partners and senior stakeholders. - Experience planning and moderating user research, including interviews with members of the public. - Hands-on experience designing complex, regulated, or legacy environments, where the rules are messy, the data is imperfect, and the constraints are real. - Familiarity with accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 AA, Section 508) and experience shipping products that meet them. - Familiarity designing with localization and internationalization in mind. - Content design and plain-language experience, especially in contexts where users have low trust, limited time, or limited patience for jargon. - Experience with mobile-first responsive design and designing for users on low-end devices and slow connections. - Experience handling user data with appropriate privacy and ethical considerations built into the design. - Experience contributing to or maintaining a shared design system. - Comfort with ambiguity. You can take a loosely defined problem, ask the right questions, and turn it into a buildable plan.

New York City Residency is not required for this position

omada-health-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Omada Health is on a mission to bend the curve of chronic disease.

Job overview:

As a Senior Product Designer on Omada's new care programs and innovation team, you will work closely with product managers, engineers, behavioral researchers, and data scientists to explore, design, prototype, test, and iterate on solutions that help people make lasting changes to their health.

You are a human-centered designer at heart. You deeply understand and champion our users, designing thoughtful, elegant, and effective solutions grounded in real human needs. You thrive in ambiguity, especially in 0 to 1 spaces where the problem is not yet defined and the path forward is yours to shape. You bring a strong point of view grounded in user insight, product thinking, and craft.

Our tight-knit team of designers is obsessed with creating delightful, engaging, and inclusive programs for lifelong health, medical care, and behavior change. We combine behavioral psychology, data science, and user insight to create experiences that are intuitive and impactful across a wide range of users.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will…

  • Design human-centered experiences that help people make meaningful, lasting changes to their health.
  • Take on 0 to 1 problems, turning undefined spaces into clear concepts, prototypes, and shipped experiences.
  • Frame and define the right problems to solve, identifying opportunities across the member and care team experience.
  • Drive the design process end-to-end, from concept through validation, prototyping, and final execution, in fast, iterative cycles.
  • Use rapid prototyping to explore ideas, test hypotheses, and make concepts tangible for the team.
  • Deliver consumer-grade experiences across mobile (iOS and Android), with strong visual, interaction, and systems thinking.
  • Partner with product, engineering, clinical, and research teams to shape strategy and drive aligned decisions.
  • Translate business strategy, user needs, and clinical insights into compelling product opportunities and solutions.
  • Contribute to and improve design systems, processes, and team practices.
  • Design and ship human-centered AI experiences.
  • Use AI tools as part of your design workflow to explore ideas, prototype, synthesize research, generate concepts, or accelerate design production.

We'd love to talk more if you have…

  • 6+ years of experience solving complex problems through product design, including 0 to 1 or early-stage product experience where you helped define new products or experiences from the ground up.
  • Experience designing for health, wellness, behavior change, or other complex human-centered domains.
  • A deep commitment to human-centered design, with a track record of grounding decisions in user research and real human needs.
  • Experience designing and shipping high-quality digital products on mobile (iOS and Android).
  • Strong product thinking, with the ability to frame ambiguous problems, define opportunities, and shape product direction.
  • High craft in interaction and visual design, with attention to detail and a strong sense of quality.
  • A strong bias toward making, using prototyping to explore ideas, test hypotheses, and drive decisions.
  • Experience working with and contributing to design systems.
  • Experience designing AI-powered products.
  • Experience using AI tools as part of your design workflow to explore ideas, prototype, and build, such as Figma Make, Claude Code, Cursor, or Lovable.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence decisions across teams.

Bonus points if you have…

  • Experience designing clinical, care delivery, or chronic condition management experiences.
  • Comfort running your own user research, including conducting interviews, synthesizing findings, and turning insights into design decisions.
  • You've worked in a startup setting and operate like a builder: self-driven, biased toward action, and energized by owning problems from discovery through launch.

Our Design Roots

Omada was founded in 2011 out of IDEO, where our founders explored how human-centered design could be applied to chronic health challenges. What began as an internal project grounded in deep user research evolved into a new approach to digital care.

That origin continues to shape how we work today. We place a strong emphasis on understanding real human needs, designing from first principles, and creating experiences that are not only effective, but engaging and thoughtfully crafted.

Design is not a layer at Omada. It is foundational to how we build products, make decisions, and deliver care.

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary with generous annual cash bonus
  • Equity grants
  • Employee stock purchasing plan (ESPP)
  • Remote first work from home culture
  • Flexible Time Off to help you rest, recharge, and connect with loved ones
  • Generous parental leave
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance (and above market employer contributions)
  • 401k retirement savings plan
  • Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA)
  • Mental Health Support Solutions
  • ...and more!

It takes a village to change health care. As we build together toward our mission, we strive to embody the following values in our day-to-day work. We hope these hold meaning for you as well as you consider Omada!

  • Cultivate Trust. We listen closely and we operate with kindness. We provide respectful and candid feedback to each other.
  • Seek Context. We ask to understand and we build connections. We do our research up front to move faster down the road.
  • Act Boldly. We innovate daily to solve problems, improve processes, and find new opportunities for our members and customers.
  • Deliver Results. We reward impact above output. We set a high bar, we’re not afraid to fail, and we take pride in our work.
  • Succeed Together. We prioritize Omada’s progress above team or individual. We have fun as we get stuff done, and we celebrate together.
  • Remember Why We’re Here. We push through the challenges of changing health care because we know the destination is worth it.

About Omada Health: Omada Health (Nasdaq: OMDA) is reverse engineering the way healthcare is delivered in America, putting the space between doctor visits–where health is won or lost–at the center of care. Today's healthcare system poorly serves chronic conditions that require ongoing support outside of the exam room, like obesity, diabetes, hypertension, cholesterol, and musculoskeletal conditions. Omada’s virtual-first model combines human-led care teams, connected devices, and AI-enabled technology to deliver personalized care at scale, including support for GLP-1 therapy. Omada has served more than two million members since launch across 2,000+ employers, health plans, pharmacy benefit managers, and health systems. Learn more at omadahealth.com.

Omada is thrilled to share that we’ve been certified as a Great Place to Work! Please click here for more information.

We carefully hire the best talent we can find, which means actively seeking diversity of beliefs, backgrounds, education, and ways of thinking. We strive to build an inclusive culture where differences are celebrated and leveraged to inform better design and business decisions. Omada is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.
