tavus-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Tavus is an AI research lab pioneering human computing. We’re building PALs: a new kind of application that closes the gap between people and machines, free from the friction of today’s systems. Our real-time human simulation models let machines see, hear, respond, and even look real—enabling meaningful, face-to-face conversations. PALs combine the emotional intelligence of humans with the reach and reliability of machines, making them capable, trusted agents available 24/7, in every language, on our terms.

Imagine a therapist anyone can afford. A personal trainer that adapts to your schedule. A fleet of medical assistants that can give every patient the attention they need. With Tavus, individuals, enterprises, and developers can all build PALs to connect, understand, and act with empathy at scale.

We’re a Series B company backed by world-class investors including Sequoia Capital, Y Combinator, and Scale Venture Partners.

Be part of shaping a future where humans and machines truly understand each other.

The Role

We are seeking a craft-obsessed, systems-minded Product Designer to evolve our product suite and own & grow the Tavus design systems – the components, tokens, and patterns that every surface we build on top of depends on.

This is a Product Design role that demands exceptional VisD skills and experience. We need someone with exceptional eye and hand for typography, color, spacing, and detail, who can bring real motion craft to how our system feels in use. But the design system doesn't exist in a vacuum: It has to hold up under real product and UX problems, across a growing portfolio of products, so strong product design judgment is a must.

This role has a deliberate arc. In the near term, your focus will be the design system: consolidating, architecting, and elevating it into something stable, distinct, and built to scale with us. As that foundation matures, we expect this role to evolve into ownership of a product area, where you'll carry the same craft and judgment forward into shipping product day to day. We're looking for someone genuinely excited by both halves.

You will collaborate closely with product, engineering, and leadership in a fast-paced environment to make the system the clear, trusted foundation for how we design and build. Join our small, creative team of designers, engineers, and product enthusiasts dedicated to thoughtfully bridging the human-machine divide. We're doing it right, sweating the details, and we're in it together.

This role is based in the San Francisco Bay Area.

What You'll Do

  • Architect for scale: Define the token architecture, component structure, and theming model (light, dark, and beyond) that let the system flex across products and surfaces without forking or drifting.

  • Own governance, not just files: Establish the standards, documentation, and contribution model that keep the system coherent as more designers and engineers touch it. Be the clear, decisive voice when tradeoffs get contentious.

  • Partner deeply with engineering: Work hand-in-hand with frontend engineers to ensure the system is implemented faithfully and effectively.

  • Elevate craft everywhere: Bring meticulous visual and interaction craft, including motion and micro-interaction detail, to every component and pattern so the system doesn't just function, it feels intentional and distinctly Tavus. “Good enough” isn’t.

  • Drive adoption: Make the system easier to use than not using it. Build the artifacts, documentation, and relationships that get other designers, engineers, and marketers to reach for the system first.

Who You Are

  • An indefatigable visual designer, with an exceptional, well-trained eye for typography, color, layout, and detail, plus real motion design chops.

  • A genuinely capable product designer, with 6+ years of experience and solid UX judgment. You understand user flows, interaction patterns, and product tradeoffs well enough that your systems hold up with elegance under real product pressure.

  • Experienced building and governing design systems at scale. You can point to a system you've architected and evolved, not just contributed to, with bonus points for work both within an existing component framework as well as from-scratch builds.

  • Original, not just tasteful. We're not looking for someone who can recognize good design when they see it; we're looking for someone who can produce something distinct that hasn't been seen before. If your portfolio could pass for a dozen other SaaS products, this isn't the right fit. We'll ask you to walk us through specific decisions and the reasoning behind them, and the results those decisions yielded.

  • Principled and able to defend it. You’re especially adept at articulating why a decision is correct. You push back on your own instincts as readily as you push back on others'.

  • Decisive in ambiguity: You don't need permission to make a call. When a system decision has no clean answer, you weigh the tradeoffs, make a defensible choice, and move, while staying meticulous about the details within that decision.

  • Technically fluent: You're comfortable working close to code: reviewing implementation, catching and stopping drift between design and build, and speaking the language of the engineers who ship your system.

  • Built for startup pace: You can operate with minimal specs and shifting priorities, protecting the highest quality bar while moving fast.

Benefits & Culture

When you join Tavus, you’re joining a diverse and supportive team. Our work is driven by our people, and our success is shared by all. This position has a flexible work schedule, unlimited PTO, competitive healthcare, and gear stipends, as well as plenty of fun. At the end of the day, we want Tavus to be a place for you to learn, directly drive impact, and work with a team you love.

To learn more about our team culture and benefits, check out our hiring page.

Tavus is growing fast, and we’d like you to grow with us. If you’re excited to get your hands dirty and help make machines more human, drop your resume and we’ll be in touch.

We are not looking for cultural fits, we are looking for culture creators. Diversity is what drives our success – it’s at the core of how we hire, communicate, and work. We are inclusive to all and combine our diverse backgrounds, skill sets, and perspectives to build the best experiences for our clients.

teamsnap-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
🌎 About Us

At TeamSnap, we believe when the world connects through sports; the world becomes better. TeamSnap is a sports and communication platform dedicated to taking the work out of play in youth sports. We also believe our jobs should excite us, our teammates should support us and our bosses should inspire us. We empower our people to bring big ideas and tiny egos, landing us on Outside Magazine’s list of “Best Places to Work" and Built In’s “100 Best Remote-First Places to Work."

TeamSnap is looking for a Senior Product Designer who will craft experiences that connect parents, coaches and players to make youth sports more fun. You will partner closely with product and engineer partners to drive features from discovery through execution. You’ll play a key role in establishing consistency, ease of use and innovation across TeamSnap consumer experiences.

What You'll Do:

  • Design high-impact, consistent, and intuitive user experiences across platforms, considering market trends, customer feedback, and quantitative data.
  • Conduct user research and leverage insights to define product requirements, using sketches, wireframes, and prototypes to guide the ideation process.
  • Use a data-driven approach to tie design decisions to user research while balancing business goals and technical constraints.
  • Partner closely with product managers and engineers to refine requirements, validate designs, and iterate based on feedback.
  • Manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, maintaining a sense of urgency while delivering high-quality designs.
  • Shape, improve, and maintain the TeamSnap design system.
  • Partner with marketing designers to ensure brand consistency across all digital products.

What Will Set You Up for Success:

  • 4+ years of experience as a product designer or a similar role, building digital products with increasing responsibility.
  • Degree in design, human-computer interaction (HCI), or equivalent.
  • Experience in web and app development. Bonus points if you have experience with both B2B and B2C software.
  • An online portfolio that demonstrates the ability to turn high-level ideas and vision into a strong and unique UX and creative solutions with the success metrics to prove it.
  • Expertise in using Figma and prototyping tools.
  • Experience working in tight collaboration and influencing product, engineering, and marketing teams, with the ability to synthesize feedback and input from peers and stakeholders.
  • Demonstrated ability to understand and discuss technical concepts and cost/benefit tradeoffs of different design solutions.

Got cold feet? If you’re thinking you don’t meet 100% of the above qualifications, you should still seriously consider applying. We’re all humans with special talents that go beyond what’s listed here.

Compensation

We’re committed to equitable compensation for all TeamSnappers. The minimum starting point for this role is $130,000, inclusive of base and bonus, with comp updated based on multiple factors. Our comp is highly competitive in our space and we adjust overall comp based on relevant experience, skills, certifications, and geographic location.

🖥 Location

TeamSnap is a fully remote company, so you need to be very comfortable working with people who aren’t in the same time zone as you. We are always expanding, but there is a small list of states we do not hire in, including Alabama, Alaska, Delaware, District of Columbia, Hawaii, Iowa, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nebraska, New Mexico, Rhode Island, South Dakota West Virginia and Utah and while we love all parts of the world, we can only hire permanent US residents at this time.

🚀 Opportunities to Grow

At TeamSnap, we work hard to provide a culture of trust, accountability, inclusivity, and boundless opportunities to grow, along with the chance to make a lasting impact and have some fun while doing it.

🎩 Total Rewards

• W e're proud to be remote-first. We've been remote since 2009, long before COVID made it cool

• Unlimited PTO and paid parental leave for ALL parents (not just primary or secondary)

• 100% premium coverage of medical/dental/vision for you and your family

• 401K to help you invest for the future

• $1,500 annual learning and development stipend

• Travel to fun locations for all-company meetings and team events

• Generous home office allowance to set you up for success

• TeamSnap SWAG to our store upon starting and a $50 credit on every work anniversary thereafter

• A monthly stipend reimbursement for health & wellness and so much more!

• TeamSnap Total Rewards

🏆 Working at TeamSnap

At TeamSnap, you're not a culture fit, you're a culture add. Check out our Culture Playbook and learn how we succeed at being remote-first, what makes our company so unique, and how we're inspired by our people, our customers, and our values.

🧡 Inclusion and Diversity

Creativity and innovation can't thrive when we're cookie-cutter images of each other. We’re quickly growing more diverse, but there's always room for improvement. We are committed to inclusion and diversity at TeamSnap, and we hold ourselves accountable for building an environment where everyone feels valued. If you need any disability-related adaptation during the recruitment process, just let us know! We are an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer.

tennr-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Company Description

Today, when you go to your doctor and get referred to a specialist (e.g., for sleep apnea), your doctor sends out a referral and tells you, “They’ll be in touch soon.” So you wait. And wait. Sometimes days, weeks, or even months. Why? Because too often specialists and medical services are overwhelmed with referrals and the painstakingly manual process it takes to qualify your referral prevents them from getting around to it on time, or sometimes at all. Tennr prevents these delays and denials by making sure every referral gets where it needs to go, with the right info, at the right time. Powered by RaeLM™ Tennr reads, extracts, and acts on every piece of patient information so providers can capture more referrals, slash denials, and reduce delays.

Role Description

As an early designer at Tennr, you'll leverage your design expertise to the product that reduces patient delays across the U.S Healthcare System.

We are looking for a Senior Product Designer who is passionate about tackling the most complex challenges in healthcare and isn’t afraid to own them. Someone who skillfully parses through ambiguity and deeply cares about creating the best possible experiences. You’ll report directly to a co-founder to help inform our roadmap and problems to work on.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong ambition to tackle a high-impact problem space, who can thrive in a fast-paced startup environment and is eager to contribute to foundational aspects across product, design, and processes.

Responsibilities

  • Take full design ownership across multiple project streams, leading the entire product design process from research to development handoff and post-release analysis and support.
  • Collaborate with the team to prioritize the product roadmap and shape product strategy and direction.
  • Conduct user interviews, validate ideas with customers, define key problems to solve, analyze feedback, distill insights, and iterate on design to ensure alignment with business goals.
  • Create high-fidelity interactive prototypes and ensure smooth development handoff. Manage constraints related to scope and deadlines.
  • Be an active contributor to our Design System.
  • Contribute to ongoing improvements in the design and development process.

Qualifications

  • You excel at breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into clear, actionable projects.
  • You communicate ideas effectively—from high-level abstraction to pixel-level detail—clearly articulating the trade-offs involved.
  • You have a passion for visual precision and a strong commitment to iterating on your work until it reaches customers at the highest level of quality. Your dedication inspires engineering and product partners to uphold the same standard of excellence.
  • You are self-organized and confident in managing cross-functional stakeholders.
  • You are adaptable and thrive in fast-paced, ever-changing environments. You can respond quickly to shifts in direction and know how to manage scope within tight time constraints.
  • You have 5+ years of experience in relevant roles, ideally within startups or high-growth environments.

Why Tennr?

  • Drive Impact: one of our company values is Cowboy, meaning you set the pace. You won’t just talk about things, you’ll get them done. And feel the impact.
  • Develop Operational Expertise: learn the inner workings of scaling systems, tools, and infrastructure
  • Innovate with Purpose: we’re not just doing this for fun (although we do have a lot of fun). At Tennr, you’ll join a high-caliber team maniacally focused on reducing patient delays across the U.S. healthcare system.
  • Build Relationships: collaborate and connect with like-minded, driven individuals in our Chelsea office 4 days/week (preferred)
  • Free lunch! Plus a pantry full of snacks.

Benefits

  • New, spacious Chelsea office
  • Unlimited PTO
  • 100% paid employee health benefit options
  • Employer-funded 401(k) match
  • Competitive parental leave

thorin-ai-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Thorin

Today's enterprise software is better than ever, but most organizations still run on conversations rather than systems.

Critical work lives across Slack, email, meetings, documents, and people's heads. Existing tools depend on humans to manually update records, push projects forward, and make sure important work doesn't fall through the cracks.

We believe AI should do more.

Thorin is building proactive, long-horizon AI agents that continuously understand what is happening across an organization and help teams execute over weeks, months, and years. Rather than waiting for prompts, Thorin develops a living understanding of how a business actually operates.

Born out of 8VC's Build program and backed by one of Silicon Valley's strongest venture ecosystems, Thorin is building the operating system for the AI-native enterprise.

About the Role

We are looking for a Founding Product Designer to help define what product design looks like in the age of AI.

This is not a traditional product design role. We are looking for someone who thinks like a builder, not just a designer.

You will be our first design hire and help establish how product, engineering, and design work together. You'll partner directly with founders, product leaders, and engineers to shape product strategy, define user experiences, prototype ideas, and help build the systems our customers use every day.

We're looking for someone who is excited by ambiguity and energized by building from first principles. You'll help define the product while helping define the design function itself.

As AI changes how software is built, we believe design is evolving as well. We want someone who embraces that future—someone curious about AI-native workflows, rapid prototyping, and new ways of collaborating across product and engineering.

This role leads primarily through execution, influence, and product judgment rather than hierarchy.

What You'll Do

  • Design AI-native product experiences from concept through implementation.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to define customer problems before designing solutions.

  • Prototype, test, and iterate rapidly with customers and internal teams.

  • Help establish design systems, interaction patterns, and product standards.

  • Contribute to product strategy, roadmap discussions, and long-term product vision.

  • Build trust with engineers through close collaboration and shared ownership.

  • Support company-wide design needs including recruiting, sales, marketing, and brand as the company scales.

  • Help build the foundation of the design organization as Thorin grows.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have experience designing Ai-powered products in startup or zero-to-one environments.

  • You think like a product builder, not simply a UX designer.

  • You enjoy solving ambiguous problems from first principles.

  • You are comfortable partnering deeply with engineers and product managers.

  • You have exceptional product judgment and know how to simplify complex workflows.

  • You are curious about AI and excited by how it is changing product development.

  • You move quickly, iterate often, and value learning over perfection.

  • You care deeply about customer outcomes rather than polished deliverables.

  • You are excited to help build both a product and a company.

Nice to Have

  • Frontend implementation experience (React, HTML/CSS, or modern prototyping tools).

  • Experience using AI to prototype, generate ideas, critique designs, or accelerate product development.

  • Previous founder, founding employee, or early-stage startup experience.

Who This Role Is Not For

  • Designers who prefer highly defined requirements before getting started.

  • Designers who primarily focus on visual polish over product outcomes.

  • People looking for a narrowly scoped design role.

  • Individuals who prefer handing designs to engineering rather than building alongside them.

  • People uncomfortable with ambiguity, rapid iteration, or changing priorities.

Benefits & Perks

Health & Wellness

  • 100% employer-paid medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • $200/month wellness stipend

  • 401(k)

Commuting & Office Life

  • $300/month transportation stipend

  • $500/month development tool budget

  • Prime office location at Market Street & 3rd in San Francisco

  • Office setup support for the tools and equipment you need

Food & Community

  • $25/day lunch stipend

  • $35/day snacks and incidental office expenses

  • Weekly team dinners and social events

Building Together

  • Be our founding designer and help define the future of AI-native product design.

  • Work side-by-side with founders and an exceptional early team.

  • High ownership and direct impact from day one.

  • Backed by 8VC and one of the strongest venture ecosystems in Silicon Valley.

Compensation

The expected base salary range for this role is $165,000–$235,000, plus meaningful equity and benefits.

Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, demonstrated product judgment, and expected scope. As a founding member of the team, equity will be an important part of the overall compensation package.

thunkable-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Role Overview

As a Product Designer at Thunkable, you’ll solve complex problems - spanning the product, engineering and marketing organizations and be responsible for the features and projects you bring to life. You will work closely with our engineering team to define features as well as with our marketing team to support growth efforts.

Key Responsibilities

  • Deeply understand our users and their pain points through customer conversations, user research, interviews, and usability testing.

  • Design intuitive user flows and interaction patterns while contributing to and evolving our design system.

  • Create polished, high-quality interfaces with strong attention to usability, accessibility, visual clarity, and consistency.

  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to transform sophisticated technical systems into simple and elegant user experiences.

  • Prototype and iterate quickly, balancing speed with craft in a fast-moving startup environment.

  • Present and communicate design decisions clearly, connecting user experience choices to broader product strategy and business goals.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally with engineering, product, data, and marketing teams to bring ideas from concept to launch.

  • Help improve overall product consistency, interaction quality, and design standards across the platform.



Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of experience in product design, with strong foundations in UX research, information architecture, interaction design, and visual design.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating thoughtful product thinking, polished visual execution, and end-to-end product design work.

  • Expertise with modern design and prototyping tools such as Figma

  • Experience working in a fast-paced, growth-stage startup environment.

  • Strong design craft with a passion for building experiences that are both beautiful and highly functional.

  • Ability to think from first principles, simplify complexity, and craft elegant solutions.

  • Comfort operating in ambiguity and moving quickly through 0→1 product development, rapid iteration, and experimentation.

  • Strong product intuition and ownership mindset, with the ability to independently drive projects from concept to launch.

  • Technical fluency with the ability to collaborate deeply with engineering teams on AI-native products, developer workflows, or technically sophisticated systems.

  • Familiarity with mobile app ecosystems, mobile-first product design, and responsive UX patterns.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to write clear, concise, conversion-oriented product copy.

  • Familiarity with no-code or low-code development platforms is highly preferred.

Nice to Have

  • Experience using modern AI-powered design and creative tools such as Claude, ChatGPT, AI-assisted prototyping tools, or emerging AI-native design workflows to accelerate ideation, prototyping, content generation, and product iteration.

  • Experience designing AI-native or generative AI products.

  • Familiarity with front-end development, design systems implementation, or close collaboration with engineering teams on highly technical workflows.

  • Experience working on mobile-first products, creator tools, developer platforms, or no-code / low-code products.

tomo-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Tomo is building this generation's most important consumer AI product.

We have been working quietly on a SOTA personal agent that learns what real people care about and empowers them to lead better lives.

Now, we’re using their context to build a living, breathing operating system unique to each user, dynamically generating interfaces in real-time to further empower them to live life with greater agency.

The early results has been phenomenal, with world-class retention and engagement metrics. We've improved thousands of active paying users' lives, even saving a few of them.

We have the data, we have the revenue, we have the funding, now we’re hiring only our kindest and smartest friends.

Apply for the Founding Product Designer role if you

  • have strong opinions on what real-time generative interfaces should look like

  • believe LLMs have enabled a "god in a box" consumer product (that isn't chat) and want to design that box

  • Claude Code / Cursor your way through designs in order to feel them

  • express your taste through different mediums for the love of the game

  • feel equally strong obligations to both 1) choose good and 2) to win.

  • think our current designs are ugly

town-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Town

Town is building an AI partner that learns you, then gets to work — right where you already work. It comes to know your voice, your people, and your priorities, and shows up across your email, calendar, and messages to take real work off your plate.

The idea is simple: you shouldn't have to learn AI, AI should learn you.

We're a small, talent-dense team (~25 people) backed by Andreessen Horowitz, Forerunner Ventures, First Round Capital, and Conviction, with more than $73M raised to date. We ship quickly and obsess over quality. The product is genuinely new — agents, routines, skills, and integrations woven into how people actually work — which means the interaction paradigms haven't been invented yet. That's the fun part, and it's the part we want you to own.

The Role

You'll be an early product designer at Town, working closely with our CPO and current designer to take real ownership of core product surfaces. You'll move from a vague problem to a shipped, polished feature without a single handoff, because there's no one to hand off to: you design it, you prototype it, and you push the front-end yourself. With AI in the loop there's no fixed playbook — some problems need you to step back and think from first principles, others just need you to iterate live in code and execute.

This is a high-ownership, high-craft role for someone who is energized by ambiguity, ships constantly, and cares about the last 5% as much as the first 80%.

What you'll do

  • Own surfaces end-to-end. Take core product areas — think People, Content Library, permissions and approvals, onboarding, agent and routine experiences — from problem definition through high-fidelity design to shipped code. You're accountable for the outcome, not just the artifact.

  • Design the interaction paradigms for AI. Translate genuinely complex capabilities — agents acting on a user's behalf, multi-step routines, approvals, trust and control — into interfaces people understand and trust at a glance. Much of this has no precedent; you'll define it.

  • Build, don't just spec. Prototype in real code and ship front-end yourself. We pair Figma with AI-assisted coding (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, etc) and commit directly to the product repo. You don't need to be a staff engineer, but you should be dangerous in the codebase and want to get more so.

  • Pair tightly with engineering, product, and the founders. We're small enough that you'll work directly with the CEO, CPO, and the engineers who own each surface. Influence here comes from good work and good arguments, not headcount.

  • Talk to users and use research as velocity. Run quick conversations and tests to make sharper decisions faster — research as an accelerator, not a gate.

  • Grow the design system. Help evolve a shared, opinionated system (we sweat OkLCH color, motion, and the details) so the whole product feels considered and consistent.

  • Contribute to brand and the bigger moments. Pitch in on launches, the marketing site, and the occasional motion/asset work — designers here flex across product and brand when it matters.

What we're looking for

  • A portfolio of shipped product work where the craft is obviously high — clean UI, considered interactions, real attention to detail. We care far more about what you've made than about years or pedigree.

  • Roughly 6+ years designing and shipping software, ideally in fast-moving startups, B2B/SaaS, productivity, or technical/developer tools. If your work is exceptional, the number matters less.

  • Comfort owning a problem from ambiguous start to shipped finish, in an environment that moves fast and changes often.

  • The ability (and appetite) to prototype and ship in code — HTML/CSS/JS and AI-assisted coding tools. Designers who build are how we move at our speed.

  • Fluency in Figma and modern design workflows.

  • Genuine curiosity about AI and how people should interact with it — and a point of view about what makes those experiences trustworthy and delightful.

  • An owner's mentality: you treat the product like it's yours, because it will be.

Nice to have

  • Experience designing AI-native or agent-based products.

  • A background that blends design and engineering (design engineer, front-end-leaning designer).

  • Prior "first or second designer" experience at an early-stage company.

How we work

  • In-office together in SF or NYC, five days a week — we think the best early-stage design happens in the room.

  • Small team, flat structure, very little process. High trust, high autonomy, high standards.

  • We ship fast and frequently, then sweat the details until they're right.

unlearn-product-designer-contract.descriptionHtml:
Our Mission and Vision

Unlearn exists to transform clinical development by making every trial smarter. We harness data, AI, and digital twins to enable faster, more robust studies that bring life-saving treatments to patients faster. This mission drives everything we do as we partner with biopharmaceutical companies to redesign how clinical trials are planned, run, and analyzed.

We are defining the future of clinical development with unmatched scientific credibility, replacing uncertainty with AI-powered precision so decisions are clearer and trials are stronger. We don’t just disrupt the pharmaceutical industry, we create lasting change.

We believe AI will define the future of medicine, and we are committed to building that future responsibly, rigorously, and in close collaboration with our partners in clinical development.

About Our Team

We come from a variety of backgrounds ranging from machine learning to marketing—but regardless of where we come from, Unlearners share some common traits:

  • Unlearners are ambitious; we aren’t intimidated by big, challenging goals.

  • Unlearners are disciplined experimenters; we break down our big goals into smaller chunks and meet as often as necessary to track our velocity and iterate quickly.

  • Unlearners are gritty; we never give up, setbacks just make us try harder.

  • Unlearners are receptive to new ideas; in fact, we hate being stuck with the status quo

  • Unlearners are storytellers; sharing information with each other and with the world is super important, too important to be boring. And, last but not least,

  • Unlearners are team-oriented; we put the mission first, the company second, the team third, and individuals last.

Headquartered in San Francisco, Unlearn was founded in 2017 by a team of world-class machine learning scientists. We have raised venture capital from top tier investors such as Altimeter, Insight Partners, Radical Ventures, 8VC, DCVC, and DCVC Bio, and completed our $50 million Series C in January 2024.

If our purpose and culture resonate with you, we invite you to apply.

Type: Contract, 30–40 hrs/week

Location: Hybrid, San Francisco

Duration: 6 months; potential to convert to full-time

Role

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our team on a contract basis and help build out the Unlearn Platform - a connected product suite powered by digital twin technology, data and AI that helps clinical development teams drive decisions across the trial lifecycle. You'll own end-to-end design for features within a defined product area — taking work from discovery through prototyping, validation, and delivery — in close partnership with PMs and Engineering. You'll work within our existing design system and design patterns, applying a high bar for craft while moving quickly.

This is a hands-on execution role. We are designing highly technical, industry-specific, data-rich tools with complex workflows. The ideal candidate is a strong maker who's comfortable with ambiguity at the feature level, communicates design decisions clearly, and is energized by complex, data-rich problems. There's meaningful potential for this contract to convert to a full-time position for the right fit.

What You'll Do

  • Design end-to-end for assigned features — from discovery and concept through prototyping, validation, and delivery

  • Collaborate day-to-day with Product Management, Engineering and Science to build intuitive, elegant user experiences.

  • Produce high-fidelity mockups and interactive prototypes that meet our standards for quality and consistency.

  • Apply and extend our existing design system rather than build it from scratch.

  • Lead user research and usability testing; translate findings into design improvements.

  • Develop a working understanding of our biopharma customers' workflows and pain points.

Who You Are

  • Craftsperson. You hold a high bar for design quality, and you also know when to ship, learn, and iterate.

  • User-centered. You start with empathy and advocate for user needs while respecting business and technical realities.

  • Curious & intentional. You ask "why," sweat the details, and can clearly explain the rationale behind your decisions.

  • Collaborative. You thrive in multidisciplinary teams and integrate input from product management, science and engineering.

  • Resilient & adaptable. You stay focused through churn, ambiguity, and iteration.

Qualifications

  • 3–5 years of product design experience, with a portfolio showing strong interaction design, visual design, and problem-solving.

  • Experience designing complex workflows or analytic tools (data visualization experience is a strong plus).

  • Fluent working within an existing design system.

  • Expert in Figma and modern prototyping tools.

  • Strong communication and storytelling; able to articulate and defend design decisions.

  • Experience contributing to user research and usability testing.

  • Comfortable in a fast-paced, agile environment, managing multiple efforts at once.

  • Exposure to 0→1 product work is a plus.

  • Knowledge of healthcare, biopharma, or clinical trials is a plus, not required.

What a Great Portfolio Looks Like

  • Case studies that describe goals, research insights, constraints, concepts, tradeoffs, and impact.

  • Evidence of craft and clear problem-solving — not just visual polish.

  • Work involving data-rich or workflow-heavy products.

Benefits & Perks

The following benefits and perks are for full time roles only.

  • Generous equity participation

  • 100% company-covered medical, dental, & vision insurance plans

  • 401k plan with matching

  • Flexible PTO plus company holidays

  • Annual company-wide break December 24 through January 1

  • Commuter benefits

  • Paid Parental Leave

Unlearn is an equal opportunity employer.

At Unlearn, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace, because inclusion and diversity are essential to achieving our mission. If you’re excited about this role, and your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply nevertheless.

valence-principal-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Valence has built the only AI native coaching platform for enterprise, offering personalized, expert, and human-like guidance and support to any leader or employee. We’re not just talking about the future of work — we’re building it now, with the most innovative Fortune 500 companies across healthcare, financial services, manufacturing, and technology.


Learn more about our work with Microsoft: Valence Brings AI Coaching More Deeply Into the Flow of Work with Microsoft 365

Our focus is on the problems that actually decide whether AI changes how organizations operate — the ones with no playbook, no obvious answers, and no guarantee of success. If you want to be part of the small group that defines how AI transforms the future at a global scale, this is your chance.

And this isn’t for everyone. We’re not looking for people who want predictability or incremental progress. We only want those who are restless at the edge of what’s possible, who get bored when things feel “done,” and who are driven to redefine what AI can mean for leaders, companies, and the world. Because at Valence, the work worth doing is the kind that redefines work itself.

The Role

This is a rare opportunity to define what consumer-grade AI coaching experiences look like at enterprise scale. You’ll join as a senior design leader on a small, high-velocity product-design-engineering team, where your work will directly shape how millions of users interact with AI coaching every day. This role is exciting because:

  • Redefine the paradigm: Conversational and LLM-driven interfaces are still early. You’ll challenge existing patterns and establish new standards for AI-native product experiences.

  • Design as a strategic unlock: At Valence, design isn’t decoration — it’s central to trust, engagement, and adoption. Your work will directly accelerate our product and company.

  • True partnership: You’ll work alongside product and engineering leaders who deeply value design and involve it in every major decision.

  • AI-native from day one: We’re building from first principles, not layering AI onto legacy systems.

  • High performing PDE culture: We operate as a tight, collaborative team with intentional practices that make distributed work effective and energizing.

About Valence

We're the only company pioneering leadership coaching for large enterprises in an AI-first way. Our mission is to transform how the world's biggest companies approach learning and development, helping teams work better together through AI-powered personalization that adapts to individual goals and organizational culture using the latest advances in machine learning and natural language processing.

We've been featured in Harvard Business Review, TIME, World Economic Forum, Financial Times, Forbes and an Inc. 5000 fastest-growing private companies in America. Our clients represent the most diverse and sophisticated enterprise AI implementations globally, including Coca-Cola, Delta, Nestlé, General Mills, Schneider Electric, Deutsche Telekom, AstraZeneca, Prudential, CVS and Bristol Myers Squibb.

Working at Valence means you'll work directly with Fortune 500 technology leaders, building expertise through the most complex enterprise deployments while gaining insight into diverse organizational approaches to AI transformation. These aren't just any enterprise clients - they're the companies defining what AI-first business transformation looks like across every major industry.

What You'll Do

  • Design features that evolve Nadia from 1:1 coaching into a multiplayer collaboration platform, including context-sharing, team dynamics, and manager tooling

  • Establish and evolve our design system to maintain craft and consistency as we scale

  • Work embedded with product and engineering to ship high-quality experiences weekly, not quarterly

  • Balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution - designing flows, refining interactions, and writing product copy yourself

  • Collaborate intensively through working sessions, critiques, and paired design work

  • Bring curiosity and experimentation to integrating AI into the user experience, exploring innovative UI and adaptive workflows.

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years of product design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating consumer-grade craft

  • Proven experience building and maintaining design systems that enable team velocity

  • A track record of shipping quickly on small, scrappy design teams (not large orgs with specialized roles)

  • Experience at a high-growth startup, helping scale from early stage to meaningful traction

  • Shipped products used by millions of users, with measurable impact on engagement or retention

  • Bonus if you have experience designing conversational interfaces, chat products, or LLM-powered experiences

You Thrive When You’re:

  • Collaborating intensively - thinking out loud, riffing in Figma, and building on others’ ideas

  • Making fast decisions with incomplete information, then iterating based on what you learn

  • Balancing craft with pragmatism - knowing when to polish and when to ship and learn

  • Working across the full stack of design, from product strategy to interaction details to content design

This Isn’t the Right Fit If You

  • Need to personally review and approve everything before it ships

  • Prefer long stretches of solo, heads-down work

  • Want clearly defined swim lanes and minimal ambiguity

  • Need large teams or heavy processes to feel productive

Why Valence

Ownership & Rapid Growth

  • Outsized missions from day one, with direct responsibility for company-defining projects

  • Work alongside the executive team with transparency into strategy and decision-making

  • Influence on direction through real-time customer feedback and market insights

AI-First Operator

  • Work directly with cutting-edge AI models and next-generation platforms

  • Build expertise in enterprise AI implementation across Fortune 500 companies and multiple industries

  • Establish yourself as a recognized leader among peers in shaping how AI transforms work at a global scale

Compensation

  • Competitive salary including base + bonuses

  • Comprehensive health coverage (medical, dental, vision) from day one

  • Generous PTO, company-wide R&R shutdowns, and paid parental leave

  • Retirement plan support for US and global employees

Equity

  • Meaningful ownership in a venture-backed company at a growth inflection point

  • Financial upside that comes from scaling fast

  • Top-up grants as we scale and you deliver exceptional performance — your compensation grows alongside your impact

Top-Performing Culture

  • A culture built for top talent: intensity to win, growth without limits, and a team that solves hard problems and celebrates big wins together

Learn more about us and meet our team here

Location and Work Environment

This can be a remote or hybrid role. NYC based candidates will be 3 days a week in office in Union Square. Candidates must be comfortable balancing colleagues in global timezones, as needed. Candidates must have valid ID/passport and must not have any restrictions on their travel abilities due to work authorization or permits.

Diversity and Inclusion

We are dedicated to creating a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels valued and supported. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and offer accommodations upon request throughout the hiring process. If you have any questions, please reach out to Allison Langille, Head of People, at jobs@valence.co.

Employment Verification & Commitment

We use third-party services to verify employment history, education, and other information relevant to your candidacy. Employment is contingent upon the successful completion of these verification checks. This is a full-time role that requires a high level of focus, availability, and commitment. Employees may not hold concurrent full-time employment with another organization while employed at Valence. Any outside consulting, advisory, freelance, or other professional work must be disclosed and approved in advance and must not interfere with job responsibilities, availability, performance, or create a conflict of interest - including risks related to confidentiality, intellectual property, or competition.

Valence is committed to protecting the privacy of all applicants. Information you submit will be used for recruiting, evaluation, legal compliance, and recordkeeping purposes only. We do not require access to personal account credentials at any stage of the hiring process. For more information, see our Candidate Privacy Notice.

#LI-HYBRID

vapi-product-designer-ai-ux.descriptionHtml:
Voice AI that resolves, not transfers.

Most phone systems trap callers in menus and scripts. Vapi is the platform for deploying voice agents that know your business and can listen, adapt, and resolve in minutes.

  • The numbers: 1 billion calls. 1 million developers. 10x enterprise ARR growth

  • The customers: Amazon Ring, ServiceTitan, New York Life, Intuit, Kavak, and thousands more, from YC startups to the Fortune 500

  • The news: a $50M Series B led by Peak XV Partners, with Bessemer Venture Partners, Kleiner Perkins, M12 (Microsoft's Venture Fund), Y Combinator, and our earlier backers. Total raised: $72M

Product Designer — AI UX / Product Experience

Location: SF (hybrid Tuesday-Thursday)

About Vapi (/ˈVɑːpi/):
We're creating the shift to voice as humanity's default interface.
We're the most configurable platform for deploying voice agents.
We've grown to over 1M developers, adding thousands every day.
Try talking to Vapi now!

Why We're Hiring This Role

We're building the next generation of AI product experiences and need someone who shapes product direction, not just executes on it. We want a designer who can help us see problems in new ways, raise the quality of our thinking, and create clear, high-leverage product experiences in a fast-moving AI environment.

What You'll Do

30 Day:
Go deep on our complex, technical workflows. Understand the product surface end to end and how customers actually use it.

60 Day:
Own an ambiguous problem area outright. Partner closely with engineering and product to turn it into a clear direction, and ship high-quality work quickly and iteratively.

90 Day:
Contribute novel ideas and patterns that help define how AI-native workflows should work in practice. Be a voice that raises the level of the team, not just execution capacity.

Who You Are

  • 5+ years experience: Exceptional candidates with less considered case by case

  • Exceptional taste: You bring product and design judgment, not just solid execution; strong fundamentals and a modern design sensibility

  • AI-Forward: You design with and around AI-augmented workflows, not just for AI products

  • A rigorous thinker: You frame ambiguous problems clearly and ask sharp questions before jumping to solutions

  • A systems thinker: With range, not at the expense of creativity and product insight

  • B2B / enterprise background: You've designed for enterprise or B2B products, not legacy enterprise software (think Linear or Vercel, not Salesforce, Workday, or Microsoft)

  • Comfortable with complexity: You're at home designing highly technical products and workflows

  • Fluent in AI: You have up-to-date intuition for AI products, tooling, and workflow design

  • Provably original: Your work has introduced new ideas, patterns, or ways of thinking to a team

  • Fast in fast-moving environments: You've designed and shipped inside iterative, high-velocity product orgs

Strong Candidates May Also Have:

  • Experience at companies known for distinctive product craft or novel UX patterns (Linear, Vercel, and similar next-gen AI product companies)

  • Experience designing AI-native, workflow-heavy, or developer-facing products

  • A track record of shipping in ambiguous, high-ownership environments

  • A portfolio that shows both strong thinking and real execution

  • Technical fluency, whether from a CS background, building your own tools, or years on developer-facing products

Not A Fit If:

  • Primarily a mobile or consumer designer with no pull toward complex B2B

  • Bootcamp-only design background with no broader technical grounding

  • No prior tech industry experience

How We'll Evaluate This Role

  • How you think through ambiguous problems

  • Whether you bring genuinely new perspectives

  • Whether you can translate insight into shipped product quality

  • Whether your work raises the bar for the team

Why Vapi

  • Generational impact: Build the human interface for every business

  • Ownership culture: 70% of the company are previous founders

  • Kind team: The founders, Jordan and Nikhil, are Canadians

  • Tier-1 Investors: Peak XV, Kleiner Perkins, Bessemer, M12, YC

What We Offer

  • Real stake: We offer a competitive salary and excellent equity ownership

  • Comprehensive health coverage: medical, dental, and vision plans

  • Team love: We love hanging out, and we do quarterly off-sites

  • Flexible time off: Take what you need

  • More: Catered meals, transportation, gym, and a $10k annual L&D budget

vitvio-product-designer-ai-native-contra.descriptionHtml:
About the role

We're hiring a Lead Product Designer to join the Product & Design team at VitVio on a contract basis. This time around, we're specifically looking for someone who designs with AI at the core of their process, is comfortable using AI tools to speed up discovery and ideation, and proficient in AI-driven design to turn ideas into working, testable interfaces rather than static mockups.

You'll help define how surgical and hospital teams experience our tools: designing intuitive, high-impact interfaces that cut through complex clinical workflows and directly support better patient outcomes.

This is a hands-on role for someone who likes moving fast: exploring problems, building prototypes, testing with real users, and iterating until the details are right. You'll work across the full product lifecycle, from early discovery and research through to high-fidelity design and delivery, using AI tools throughout to move quicker without losing craft.

Day-to-day, you'll work closely with clinicians, engineers, and product stakeholders, balancing strong usability with the technical and clinical realities of the environment. Design is central to how we build at VitVio, and you'll have real influence over the product through your craft.

About you

  • Solid product design fundamentals. You can go from a rough problem to highly polished, production-ready interfaces.

  • Comfort working across the full lifecycle: discovery, research, prototyping, testing, delivery

  • Fluency in AI-native design and rapid AI-assisted prototyping as a default way of working

  • Proficiency in AI tooling. You regularly use tools like Claude, Cursor, v0, Bolt, Replit (or similar) to build functional prototypes, not just static mockups.

  • Experience planning and running user interviews independently, and synthesizing findings into design decisions

  • Working knowledge of front-end implementation principles to streamline engineering handoffs

  • Design for the hard parts of AI UX. Uncertainty, trust, transparency, and error/failure through clear system explainability, confidence indicators, graceful failure, and human oversight in safety-critical situations.

  • Proven ability to map human-AI interaction workflows by seamlessly blending prompting, output review, error correction, and the handoff of control.

  • Ability to work independently in a remote, contractor setup, with clear communication

  • Bonus: experience designing for healthcare, clinical, or other high-complexity operational environments

What we offer

  • Type: Contractor

  • Commitment: Part-time, flexible — with the option to scale up hours. There's a chance the team could expand and this will convert into a full-time role. Occasional trips to partner hospitals are expected, during which hours may increase.

  • Start date: Now

  • Location: We're remote first (European time zones). If you are based in Warsaw, Poland, then we could discuss a hybrid approach.

  • Equipment: A laptop is provided for the duration of the contract

Hiring process

  1. Screening call: 15 minutes, quick mutual fit check

  2. Whiteboard challenge: 90 minutes, you'll work through a design problem and present a solution, showing how you use AI tools to go from concept to a working prototype

  3. Offer

voicepanel-founding-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Voicepanel

Voicepanel is building the future of customer-centric product development.

AI is making it dramatically easier to build new products. But building faster doesn't eliminate the need for customer feedback—it increases it. As teams ship more ideas, experiments, and AI-powered experiences, they need faster ways to understand what customers think and whether they're making the right decisions.

Voicepanel helps companies evaluate products with real people at the speed of modern product development. Our platform recruits participants, gathers feedback, and transforms it into structured evidence that helps teams make better decisions. Leading product teams use Voicepanel to validate ideas, improve experiences, and launch with greater confidence.

We're a veteran team of product builders from Google, Microsoft, Apple, and leading startups. We're backed by Y Combinator and founders of companies including Dropbox, Instacart, Optimizely, Airtable, and Gusto.

About the role

We're looking for an exceptional founding designer to help define a new category.

As our first designer, you'll work directly with the founders to shape every aspect of Voicepanel, from core product experiences to brand, storytelling, and the overall quality bar of the company.

This is not a role for someone who wants to optimize an existing design system. It's a role for someone who wants to invent new interaction models, rethink how people interact with AI, and help define what great product design looks like in an AI-native world.

What you'll own

  • Reimagine how people give feedback to companies. We’re building a new kind of feedback experience that spans conversations, usability tests, mobile screen recordings, prototypes, concepts, images, videos, and entirely new interaction models that don’t exist yet. You'll craft delightful experiences that respondents genuinely enjoy while delivering rich, high-quality signals that help companies make better decisions.
  • Design exceptional experiences for modern product teams. Shape the workflows customers use to evaluate products, collect feedback, analyze results, and drive decisions. Deeply understand how teams work across their product stack—including AI tools, design systems, and MCP-powered workflows—and transform sophisticated capabilities into experiences that feel intuitive, trustworthy, and delightful.
  • Help define a new category. We're building something without established patterns or playbooks. You'll help invent the interaction models, design principles, and quality standards that define how customer-informed product development works in an AI-native world.

What makes you a fit

  • Exceptional product taste and attention to detail
  • Strong systems thinking and ability to simplify complex workflows
  • Comfortable designing and building with modern AI tools
  • Curious, collaborative, and energized by ambiguity
  • Comfortable moving between strategy, interaction design, and implementation details
  • Obsessed with quality and willing to sweat details others overlook

Why this role is special

  • Define a category. Product development is being reinvented by AI. You'll help define how customer-informed decision making works in an AI-native world.
  • Own the core experience. We believe customer feedback should become as embedded in product development as code review. You'll shape the experiences that make that possible.
  • Design and build. We believe the best designers increasingly build. You'll use AI-native tools to rapidly prototype, validate, and ship ideas rather than relying on handoffs.
  • Work with exceptional people. You'll collaborate with experienced builders from Google, Microsoft, Apple, and leading startups who care deeply about craft, quality, and customer understanding.
  • Help build the company. As our first designer, you’ll be shaping the product and brand to the design culture and long-term direction of the business.

Requirements

  • Experience designing complex B2B SaaS products
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating product thinking and craft
  • Experience with dynamic AI/ML customer experiences
  • Frontend development experience (React, TypeScript, etc.)
  • Familiarity with tools like Claude, Cursor, and AI-assisted development workflows
  • Experience conducting user research or usability testing
  • Located in the San Francisco Bay Area
  • Strongly preferred: Experience working at a high-growth startup

Benefits

  • Competitive salary
  • Meaningful early-stage equity
  • Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Fully covered travel for team retreats, customer visits, and conferences

wave-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
At Wave, we help small businesses to thrive so the heart of our communities beats stronger. We work in an environment buzzing with creative energy and inspiration. No matter where you are or how you get the job done, you have what you need to be successful and connected. The mark of true success at Wave is the ability to be bold, learn quickly and share your knowledge generously.

About the Role:

As a Product Designer at Wave you will play a crucial role in the product development lifecycle. Working collaboratively with fellow product designers, researchers, content strategists, product managers, engineers, and customer support, you will craft user-centered experiences that help micro business owners thrive by crushing business financial management complexity.

Here's how you'll make an impact:

  • Working in collaboration with cross-functional product teams to navigate user and business needs during the discovery phase and iterate on product design solutions that provide desired value for our customers while focusing on the delivery.

  • Understanding and engaging in the creation and evolution of Wave's product strategy.

  • Following and helping improve Wave’s user-centric design principles

  • Help us build and maintain our Design Systems libraries while building innovative products.

  • Working with the Product Manager and the Engineer Lead to prioritize the discovery and delivery backlogs.

  • Creating and executing a research plan in partnership with the User Research Team, conducting concept testing, usability testing, and user interview sessions.

  • Gathering insights from research, developing hypotheses, and exploring multiple possibilities before focusing on a valuable and desirable solution, balancing user needs with business goals and strategy.

  • Mocking up and prototyping solutions following our Design Systems and continually validating, testing, experimenting, and refining your work with users.

  • Facilitating design reviews with the Product Design Team, Content Strategy, Design Systems, and all stakeholders involved in the initiative, ensuring you follow our principles and guidelines.

  • Working transparently, constantly sharing your work with fellow designers to gather feedback and improve your solution.

You'll thrive here by possessing the following:

  • You have 4+ years of professional product design experience designing for mobile and web apps, with strong knowledge of experience and visual design fundamentals.

  • You are humble, open to receive and give constructive feedback, and collaborate with the whole design team.

  • You have experience conducting research such as user interviews, usability testing, surveys, etc.

  • You use Figma as your primary design tool and have experience prototyping.

  • You are a passionate self-starter, with exceptional communication skills who is dedicated to delivering the highest quality in everything you create.

  • You thrive in an autonomous and collaborative environment while working cross-functionally to execute on various design projects from product discovery through to delivery.

  • You can stay on top of current design trends and best practices but also know when to break the mold.

  • Experience in Fintech is a plus.

At Wave, we value diversity of perspective. Your unique experience enriches our organization. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds. Let’s talk about how you can thrive here!

Wave is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible candidate experience. If you require accommodations during the recruitment process, please let us know by emailing careers@waveapps.com. We will work with you to meet your needs.

wispr-flow-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Wispr

We're building the first voice interface a billion people use every day.

Our first product, Flow, lets you talk instead of type anywhere on your computer or phone, and turns messy speech into polished text that is ready to send. It's scaled from $2M → $50M in ARR in under 12 months with millions of users and thousands of enterprise customers. How we think →

The team is still small enough that every person shapes what gets built.

About the Role

We're looking for a Product Designer to join our growing design team. This is an opportunity to shape the future of human-computer interaction for individuals and teams. You'll design cutting-edge voice interfaces, work with founders, product leads, and engineers, and build new product surfaces from scratch for millions of users.

What you'll do

  • Design new product surfaces from scratch, often with no existing product category to reference

  • Move fluidly between systems thinking (information architecture, interaction models, edge cases, how features compose with each other) and high-craft visual design (typography, motion, the details that make something feel considered)

  • Prototype fast to understand and develop new interaction problems

  • Help define and evolve our design system as we go from single-product to multi-product, so quality holds as we scale

  • Talk to users and internalize how Flow fits into their actual work

  • Ship small-to-medium code changes with AI tooling and engineering assistance

What are we looking for

  • Previous founding/startup experience, or worked at a design agency/freelancing

  • An exceptional design portfolio and track record of taste

  • Experience designing products or features that didn't have an obvious reference point: 0-to-1 work, novel interaction paradigms, or categories still being defined

  • A mix of both visual design and systems design

  • Experience with either enterprise customers or mobile/devices

  • Creativity, attention to detail, and clarity of thought

Logistics

Location. About 60% of the team is in San Francisco and the rest are remote, mostly US-based.

  • If you're in SF: you'll be in the office most days. We think the best work happens in person. Most of the team is here five days a week, and a few do three or four days depending on family or long commutes.

  • If you're remote: we're open to remote for some roles. We fly remote teammates to SF for three to four days a month.

Visa sponsorship. We sponsor visas: H1B, O1, EB1, L1, STEM + OPT, and more. We can't successfully sponsor for every role and every candidate, but if we make you an offer we'll make every reasonable effort, and we retain an immigration law firm to help.

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

  • Equity on employee-friendly terms, including extended exercise windows and a combination of ISOs and RSUs. Ask us for more details!

  • Health, dental and vision. We cover 100% of the premium on the Anthem Blue Cross Gold PPO, and 75% of premiums for dependents. (US only)

  • 401(k) with up to a 4% match. (US only)

  • Flexible time off and company holidays.

  • All meals in the office, plus commuter benefits and relocation reimbursement if you’re moving to San Francisco.

  • A high-spec laptop, monitor, and a whisper-friendly microphone.

  • Regular team events and off-sites.

  • 16 weeks of paid parental leave (12 weeks for non-birthing parent). The early days with a new baby matter more than anything we're doing here, and we want you to be present for them.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We’re designing how humans interact with AI, which makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

We are committed to ensuring a fair and accessible interview process. If you need any accommodations or adjustments, please let us know.

worktrace-ai-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About us

At Worktrace AI, our mission is to eliminate the AI divide. Frontier AI labs are developing AI that can free people to focus on meaningful, high-impact work—yet most teams don’t know where to start and are being left behind. We’re building AI that helps teams uncover their best automation opportunities and build those automations.

The role

We are hiring a Product Designer to help bring Worktrace AI’s product vision to life. As an early member of the team, you will play a critical role in shaping the user experience of our platform, from core product workflows to external brand touchpoints. This role is ideal for someone who is excited about designing products for enterprise users, enjoys working across product, web and brand, and wants to define how businesses adopt AI. You’ll collaborate closely with engineering, research, and leadership to design AI-first, complex experiences.

What you’ll do

  • Design end-to-end user flows and interfaces of the Worktrace product

  • Design enterprise dashboards and interfaces for building and running automations

  • Design and maintain worktrace.ai to be clear, compelling, and actionable

  • Maintain and evolve a consistent visual identity across all external touchpoints

You’ll excel in this role if you

  • Have 5+ years of product design experience

  • A track record of designing enterprise tools, dashboards, or automation platforms

  • Thrive in fast-paced environments and rapid iteration

  • Are excited about AI and its potential to transform how people work

Benefits and perks

  • Top-of-market salary and equity

  • Visa sponsorship

  • Generous health and dental insurance for you and dependents

  • Unlimited PTO

  • 401K

The Team

Our founders are Angela Jiang (CMU PhD), an early product manager at OpenAI who led the launches of GPT-3.5 and GPT-4, and Deepak Vasisht (MIT PhD), a CS Professor at UIUC who has deployed cutting-edge AI into industries spanning agriculture to space.

Our team includes builders from Google DeepMind, Meta, MIT, McKinsey, Twitter and FAIR. Join us.

Backed by the best in AI and Enterprise

Featured in Forbes 2026 50 AI Brink List, Worktrace is supported by a $9.4M seed round led by 8VC and Conviction, with participation from OpenAI, SV Angel, and Genius Ventures. Our angels include industry leaders such as Mira Murati (CEO of Thinking Machines Lab), Nick Turley (Head of ChatGPT), Logan Kilpatrick (Google DeepMind), and Ranveer Chandra (Microsoft).

yarn-founding-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
Video is the most compelling medium ever invented.

But even a single minute of video can take hours to make and expertise across multiple tools.

AI is changing this forever, and how we create and consume video will look completely different in 2 or 3 years time.

We’re building a creative tool for content engineers (think Cursor) along with the agentic infrastructure to scale that content to infinity (think Devin).

We’re a small experienced team based in Soho NYC.

Our investors include YCombinator, General Catalyst, Leonis Capital, Race Capital, and angels from Pika Labs, Meta, Roblox, and Adobe.

“Yarn has changed how we think about video. We’re now able to make high-retention content at scale – it feels like a secret weapon. I haven’t seen anyone else doing video like this with AI.” Varun Anand, Cofounder @ Clay

About the role

We’re building in stealth with world-class teams at companies like Clay and Shopify, and we’re looking for a founding product design role in-person in NYC.

We’ve hit an inflection point on fit with our customers and now looking to aggressively grow the team across design, engineering, and AI.

We looking for our first full-time product designer. We’re design-led and already have a strong visual designer and FE-eng capabilities in house – you will be part of a growing design team. We take design extremely seriously.

Someone with an extremely good eye, the ability to reason and think creatively, able to push the boundaries of what’s possible, and have a founder mindset with strong equity.

Things you might work on immediately

  • Design core agent interfaces and workflows.
  • Prototype new creative tool experiences using AI.

    You might also
  • Help spec and design new motion graphics templates and models.
  • Design and write WebGL shaders for special FX.
  • Jump into CSS or micro-interactions to up the polish and delight in the product.
  • Collaborate with LLM engineers on building design and taste-heavy AI experiences.

How we work

  • We believe in small, hard-working, talent-dense teams.
  • We deeply care about our customers and relentlessly iterate and collaborate with them.
  • We're generalists that enjoy picking up new challenges and learning new tech.
  • We prototype broadly across technologies and UXes, then make aggressive product plays.

zero-homes-senior-product-designer.descriptionHtml:
About Zero Homes

Our mission is to rebuild American communities through healthy, affordable homes.

At Zero Homes, we operate on a simple premise: when you make contractors successful, homeowners win. The current home services industry is fragmented, complex, and opaque, which is frustrating for homeowners and exhausting for contractors. We are changing this by building a home upgrade marketplace that enables a simple, central, transparent process for homeowners and contractors to complete projects.

Through our platform we handle design, quoting, procurement, and customer service, allowing our contractor network to focus on what they do best and make them money: delivering projects. For homeowners, this delivers a predictable, high-quality, and transparent experience—transforming home upgrades from a source of anxiety into a seamless experience.Our vision is to create a world where homeowners and contractors in all 50 states can leverage our platform to execute thousands of projects every week within the next 36 months.

We work by a clear set of values:

  • Be a "can kid," not a "can’t kid": We own our outcomes and go to extraordinary lengths to solve problems.
  • Go fast, be clear: Speed is our advantage, and we sweat the details to deliver an extraordinary customer experience.
  • Customer & Contractor Obsessed: We have a deep, personal understanding of the work to be done. We stay curious about our contractors' craft and the stories of our homeowners.
  • Win, as a team: We are building an iconic business that will reinvent the industry, and will do so together.

If you are ready to build a world-class consumer experience that genuinely rebuilds American communities, come build with us.

About the Role & Your Impact

This is an exciting opportunity to join an early stage company of talented Designers and Engineers, led by seasoned climate tech veterans. At Zero, Senior Designers are individual contributors that report to a Lead Designer. You will work in small teams (1 Designer and 1-2 Engineers) in six-week cycles to take loosely defined projects and deliver new features. Senior Designers are given broad latitude to make project-level design decisions and are expected to operate effectively with minimal oversight. We are relentlessly focused on sustainable productivity. You should expect long stretches of deep work, minimal standing meetings, and effective in person collaboration with stakeholders and peers. We value and support a healthy work-life balance so you should also expect flexibility around your personal life.

At Zero, Product Designers are generalists - they own product management, UX, and UI. Senior Product Designers will also collaborate extensively with the leadership team, helping to transform early ideas and business opportunities into a cogent product vision and roadmap. And because everyone on the team is a builder, Senior Product Designers also build early prototypes that will bring new products and features to life. We primarily use Figma, but Designers are increasingly using AI tools to accelerate ideation and prototyping.

Some examples of products that our Design team supports are the redesign of our mobile app for homeowners to scan their home, as well as a new mobile app for contractors. We are also working on the evolution of a web based design tool for HVAC systems, and various B2B web productivity tools for contractors and utilities.

What You Bring

You are a generalist with exceptional taste for design. Whether it’s researching user needs, brainstorming concepts, testing prototypes, or building features, you want to own projects from beginning to end. You have at least five years of professional product design experience and are comfortable working with sticky notes, whiteboard markers, Figma, AI tools, and front-end code (HTML/CSS/JS).

You are a detail oriented systems thinker. You want to own the whole product, not just isolated features. You always anchor your work on user needs, and are excited to meet users where they work, whether in the office or in the field. You may not have experience in climate tech or building science, but you are eager to dive into the messy world of residential electrification.

You have an eye for elegance - the confluence of beauty, effectiveness, and simplicity - and you have a proven track record of building elegant digital experiences. You value functional beauty in the physical world, and you are excited to build a product that will create healthy, comfortable, and sustainable living spaces for our customers.

You have strong opinions about AI in the Design process. Agentic design tools - Claude, Lovable, Figma Make, and whatever comes next - are a core part of how you work. You have a point of view on which problems they're great at, where they fall down, and when to keep a human in the loop. You treat your AI toolchain the way a craftsperson treats their workshop: opinionated, evolving, and always sharpened.

You are a pragmatic team player and self-starter. You have a growth mindset and love tackling complex problems. You know that products only matter if they ship. You are eager to collaborate with leaders, designers and engineers across Zero, as well as customers in the field. You know that hard decisions and tough tradeoffs are required to deliver projects within a fixed time box. You want lots of freedom, but you know that comes with the responsibility to communicate and deliver.

You are enthusiastic about in-person work. You love engaging in healthy debates with teammates and converging on solutions in real time through whiteboard sessions and collaborative workshops. You want to know your users by name, meet them in person, and you want to see them smile when they use your designs. You live within 50 miles of Denver, CO or are willing to relocate.

Nice To Haves

  • Experience with large scale consumer or B2B products

  • Experience with native mobile app design

  • Graphic design, illustration, and/or video production skills

  • Relevant industry experience: residential construction, electrification, HVAC, CAD, Solar, or Energy

  • Experience at an early-stage startup

Benefits & Compensation

📈 Meaningful equity

💸 Optional annual bonus for outstanding performance

🩺 Medical, Dental, and Vision

🏝️ 4 weeks of PTO (that we expect you to take), plus unlimited sick days

🏠 Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday in the office, and flexible working hours

🖥️ Workstation stipend

🏓 Industrial office space in RiNo with unlimited snacks, the best coffee in town, walkable access to great restaurants and amenities, and hub for community events

Zero Homes is committed to creating an inclusive and accessible experience for all candidates. We encourage you to apply even if you believe that you do not meet all of the above criteria!
